passage.traditional: 我叫王宜文，我是美國人。友美是新同學，她{1}小林，叫小林友美。她是{2}人，很可愛。友美喜歡台灣，她愛吃{3}，{4}愛喝水。

passage.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Wáng Yíwén, wǒ shì Měiguó rén. Yǒuměi shì xīn tóngxué, tā xìng Xiǎolín, jiào Xiǎolín Yǒuměi. Tā shì Rìběn rén, hěn kě'ài. Yǒuměi xǐhuān Táiwān, tā ài chī shuǐguǒ, bú ài hē shuǐ.
passage.english: My name is Wang Yiwen, and I'm American. Youmei is a new classmate. Her surname is Xiaolin, and her name is Xiaolin Youmei. She's Japanese and very cute. Youmei likes Taiwan. She loves eating fruit, and she doesn't love water.

questions.why: 姓 comes before a surname: 姓小林. 叫 then gives her full name.
日本人 means Japanese. Only a country fits before 人.
You eat 水果: 愛吃水果. 珍珠奶茶 is a drink, so it goes with 喝, not 吃.
不 goes right before the verb: 不愛喝水, she doesn't love water.

passage.traditional: 大家{1}！我姓李，{2}李中明。我是印尼人，我喜歡台灣。宜文是我同學，她是美國人。她不愛喝奶茶，愛喝{3}。你們愛喝珍珠奶茶{4}？
passage.simplified: 大家{1}！我姓李，{2}李中明。我是印尼人，我喜欢台湾。宜文是我同学，她是美国人。她不爱喝奶茶，爱喝{3}。你们爱喝珍珠奶茶{4}？

passage.english: Hello, everyone! My surname is Li, and my name is Li Zhongming. I'm Indonesian, and I like Taiwan. Yiwen is my classmate; she's American. She doesn't love milk tea; she loves tea. Do you love bubble milk tea?

questions.why: 大家好 is how you say hello to everyone.
叫 comes before the full name: 叫李中明. 姓 is only for the surname, which he already gave (姓李).
Only a drink fits after 愛喝: 茶. The other bank words are not things you drink.
嗎 at the end turns the sentence into a yes-no question.

passage.traditional: 今天是星期天，中明{1}有課。他早上九點起床，十點去學校{2}圖書館，下午五點回家吃晚飯。中明今天{3}累，明天他{4}上課，晚上九點睡覺。
passage.simplified: 今天是星期天，中明{1}有课。他早上九点起床，十点去学校{2}图书馆，下午五点回家吃晚饭。中明今天{3}累，明天他{4}上课，晚上九点睡觉。
passage.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqítiān, Zhōngmíng méiyǒu kè. Tā zǎoshàng jiǔ diǎn qǐchuáng, shí diǎn qù xuéxiào de túshūguǎn, xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn huí jiā chī wǎnfàn. Zhōngmíng jīntiān hěn lèi, míngtiān tā yào shàngkè, wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn shuìjiào.
passage.english: It's Sunday, and Zhongming has no class. He gets up at nine, goes to the school library at ten, and comes home for dinner at five. Zhongming is very tired today. He has class tomorrow, so he goes to bed at nine.

questions.why: 有 is made negative with 沒, never 不: 中明沒有課.
的 joins the owner and the thing: 學校的圖書館 (the school's library).
很 goes before a describing word like 累: 中明今天很累.
要 goes before the next action: 明天他要上課 (he has class tomorrow). 沒 is for 沒有課, and it cannot go with 明天.

passage.traditional: 今天是媽媽的生日，我和爸爸送她一些禮物。我送她兩{1}中文書，爸爸送她一{2}漂亮的衣服和一些花。紅色的花、白色的花，媽媽{3}很喜歡。晚上我們一起吃蛋糕，媽媽很{4}。
passage.simplified: 今天是妈妈的生日，我和爸爸送她一些礼物。我送她两{1}中文书，爸爸送她一{2}漂亮的衣服和一些花。红色的花、白色的花，妈妈{3}很喜欢。晚上我们一起吃蛋糕，妈妈很{4}。
passage.pinyin: Jīntiān shì māma de shēngrì, wǒ hé bàba sòng tā yìxiē lǐwù. Wǒ sòng tā liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, bàba sòng tā yí jiàn piàoliàng de yīfu hé yìxiē huā. Hóngsè de huā, báisè de huā, māma dōu hěn xǐhuān. Wǎnshàng wǒmen yìqǐ chī dàngāo, māma hěn kāixīn.
passage.english: Today is Mom's birthday, and Dad and I give her some gifts. I give her two Chinese books, and Dad gives her a pretty top and some flowers. Red flowers, white flowers: Mom likes them all. In the evening we eat cake together, and Mom is very happy.

questions.why: Books take 本: 兩本中文書. 枝 is for pens.
件 is the measure word for clothes: 一件漂亮的衣服. 枝 is for pens.
都 sums up the red and the white flowers: she likes them all.
很 needs a describing word after it: 很開心, very happy.

passage.traditional: 我和媽媽去買筆。這{1}筆很可愛，有紅色的和白色的，媽媽和我{2}喜歡白色的。紅色的一枝四十塊，白色的一枝二十塊，白色的很{3}。我們買兩枝白色{4}筆。
passage.simplified: 我和妈妈去买笔。这{1}笔很可爱，有红色的和白色的，妈妈和我{2}喜欢白色的。红色的一枝四十块，白色的一枝二十块，白色的很{3}。我们买两枝白色{4}笔。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ hé māma qù mǎi bǐ. Zhè zhǒng bǐ hěn kě'ài, yǒu hóngsè de hé báisè de, māma hé wǒ dōu xǐhuān báisè de. Hóngsè de yì zhī sìshí kuài, báisè de yì zhī èrshí kuài, báisè de hěn piányí. Wǒmen mǎi liǎng zhī báisè de bǐ.
passage.english: Mom and I go to buy pens. This kind of pen is cute. It comes in red and white, and Mom and I both like the white ones. The red ones are forty each and the white ones twenty each, so the white ones are cheap. We buy two white pens.

bank.english: (links a description to a noun, or stands for it)

questions.why: 種 means kind: 這種筆, this kind of pen. Pens never take 本.
都 comes after the group (媽媽和我) and before the verb: we both like white.
20 is less than 40, so the white ones are 很便宜, cheap.
的 links the color to the noun: 白色的筆, white pens.

passage.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì tài rè le, wǒ hěn kě. Wǒ hé Yíwén qù yì jiā yǐnliào diàn. Zhè jiā diàn mài hěn duō zhǒng yǐnliào: guǒzhī, niúnǎi, kāfēi, chá, dōu hěn hǎohē. Wǒ yào yì bēi guǒzhī, Yíwén yě yào yì bēi guǒzhī.
passage.english: It's too hot today, and I'm thirsty. Yiwen and I go to a drink shop. It sells many kinds of drinks: juice, milk, coffee and tea are all good. I get a cup of juice, and Yiwen gets one too.

questions.why: 太 goes with 了 at the end: 太熱了 means too hot.
種 means kind: 很多種飲料 means many kinds of drinks.
都 sums up the whole list: juice, milk, coffee and tea are all good.
也 means also: Yiwen gets juice too. 都 needs more than one person.

passage.traditional: 星期六，宜文{1}三個朋友去一家餐廳吃飯。那家餐廳的牛肉麵{2}好吃了，也不貴，宜文{3}天都想來吃。他們點四碗牛肉麵和四杯茶。宜文：「小姐，一共{4}錢？」
passage.simplified: 星期六，宜文{1}三个朋友去一家餐厅吃饭。那家餐厅的牛肉面{2}好吃了，也不贵，宜文{3}天都想来吃。他们点四碗牛肉面和四杯茶。宜文：「小姐，一共{4}钱？」
passage.pinyin: Xīngqíliù, Yíwén qǐng sān ge péngyǒu qù yì jiā cāntīng chī fàn. Nà jiā cāntīng de niúròu miàn tài hǎochī le, yě bú guì, Yíwén měi tiān dōu xiǎng lái chī. Tāmen diǎn sì wǎn niúròu miàn hé sì bēi chá. Yíwén: “Xiǎojiě, yígòng duōshǎo qián?”
passage.english: On Saturday, Yiwen treats three friends to a meal at a restaurant. Its beef noodles are so good, and not expensive: Yiwen wants to come every day. They order four bowls of beef noodles and four cups of tea. Yiwen: “Miss, how much is it altogether?”

questions.why: 請 + someone means to treat or invite them: 宜文請三個朋友 means Yiwen treats three friends.
太 goes with 了 at the end: 太好吃了 means so delicious.
每天 means every day: 每天都想來 means she wants to come every day.
Ask about money with 多少錢. 幾 is for small counts with a measure word, like 幾杯.

text.traditional:
友美：
我今天中午很忙，不回家吃午飯。我想去那家牛肉麵店吃麵。他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也不貴，一碗一百多塊。妳要不要一起去？我們十二點去，好嗎？
中明

questions.why: 張 counts flat furniture such as tables, beds and sofas: 一張大沙發.
台 counts machines: 一台電視 is a TV. 張 is for furniture.
也 means also: my sister is often in the living room, and the dog is often there too. 在 can't sit in front of 常常.
Put 在 + place before the action: 在我的房間裡聽音樂, listening to music in my room.

questions.why: 跟 + person + 一起 means together with someone: 我跟姐姐一起去.

在 + place comes before the action: 在椅子下面找, look under the chairs. 再 (again) sounds the same but can't come right before a place.

prompt.traditional: 今天是10月23日星期一，前天有什麼比賽？

prompt.pinyin: Jīntiān shì 10 yuè 23 rì xīngqíyī, qiántiān yǒu shénme bǐsài?
prompt.english: Today is Monday, October 23. Which match was the day before yesterday?

questions.why: 前天 is the day before yesterday: two days before Monday the 23rd is Saturday the 21st, the soccer match. Baseball on Sunday the 22nd was 昨天 (yesterday).

prompt.traditional: 我妹妹＿＿游泳，她常常去海邊游泳。
prompt.simplified: 我妹妹＿＿游泳，她常常去海边游泳。

answer.traditional: 我妹妹會游泳，她常常去海邊游泳。
answer.simplified: 我妹妹会游泳，她常常去海边游泳。
answer.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei huì yóuyǒng, tā chángcháng qù hǎibiān yóuyǒng.
answer.english: My younger sister can swim; she often swims at the beach.

questions.why: She often swims, so she 會游泳 (can swim). 不 would contradict the second part, and 太 can't go before a verb like 游泳.

answer.traditional: 今天海邊有很多人。
answer.simplified: 今天海边有很多人。
answer.pinyin: Jīntiān hǎibiān yǒu hěn duō rén.
answer.english: There are many people at the beach today.

questions.why: Place + 有 + things says what is there: 海邊有很多人. 在 needs the person first (人在海邊).

prompt.simplified: 周末我常常＿＿朋友去海边。

answer.traditional: 週末我常常跟朋友去海邊。
answer.simplified: 周末我常常跟朋友去海边。
answer.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ chángcháng gēn péngyǒu qù hǎibiān.
answer.english: On weekends I often go to the beach with friends.

questions.why: 跟 + person means with someone: 跟朋友去 means go with friends. 也 and 都 can't come before a person like this.

passage.traditional: 我的興趣是游泳和看電影。我每天早上都去游泳，游{1}很好。週末我{2}跟朋友去電影院。聽說這{3}新電影很有趣，我們星期六要去看，我{4}高興！
passage.simplified: 我的兴趣是游泳和看电影。我每天早上都去游泳，游{1}很好。周末我{2}跟朋友去电影院。听说这{3}新电影很有趣，我们星期六要去看，我{4}高兴！
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de xìngqù shì yóuyǒng hé kàn diànyǐng. Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshàng dōu qù yóuyǒng, yóu de hěn hǎo. Zhōumò wǒ yǒushíhòu gēn péngyǒu qù diànyǐngyuàn. Tīngshuō zhè bù xīn diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù, wǒmen xīngqíliù yào qù kàn, wǒ zhēn gāoxìng!
passage.english: My hobbies are swimming and watching movies. I go swimming every morning, and I swim very well. On weekends I sometimes go to the movie theater with friends. I hear this new movie is very interesting. We're going to see it on Saturday, and I'm really happy!

questions.why: Verb + 得 + description tells how well: 游得很好 means swims very well.
有時候 means sometimes: 週末我有時候跟朋友去 = on weekends I sometimes go with friends.
部 is the measure word for movies: 這部電影. 輛 is for bikes and cars.
真 + adjective means really: 我真高興 means I'm really happy.

passage.traditional: 今天是星期五，{1}是星期天。朋友覺得山上的風景{2}漂亮了，我和姐姐想去看。我{3}山上晚上有一點冷，姐姐說我們星期天早上{4}去，下午回家。
passage.simplified: 今天是星期五，{1}是星期天。朋友觉得山上的风景{2}漂亮了，我和姐姐想去看。我{3}山上晚上有一点冷，姐姐说我们星期天早上{4}去，下午回家。
passage.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqíwǔ, hòutiān shì xīngqítiān. Péngyǒu juéde shān shàng de fēngjǐng tài piàoliàng le, wǒ hé jiějie xiǎng qù kàn. Wǒ tīngshuō shān shàng wǎnshàng yǒu yìdiǎn lěng, jiějie shuō wǒmen xīngqítiān zǎoshàng yīnggāi qù, xiàwǔ huí jiā.
passage.english: Today is Friday, so the day after tomorrow is Sunday. A friend thinks the view on the mountain is so beautiful, so my older sister and I want to go and see it. I've heard it's a little cold on the mountain in the evening, so my sister says we should go on Sunday morning and come home in the afternoon.

questions.why: Two days after Friday is Sunday, so 後天是星期天. 前天 would be Wednesday.
太 goes with 了 at the end: 太漂亮了 means so beautiful. The friend loves the view, so the sisters want to see it.
我聽說 + a whole sentence means I've heard that: the writer has not been up the mountain yet, so this comes from other people. 應該 can't come right after 我 here, because no verb follows it.
應該 comes right before the verb 去: 星期天早上應該去 means we should go on Sunday morning, before the cold evening. 後天 and 前天 are time words and can't sit between 早上 and 去.

passage.traditional: 我要去郵局寄兩{1}信，可是不知道怎麼走。我先在手機上看地圖，現在我知道郵局在哪裡{2}。從我家到郵局不遠，可是今天天氣有點熱，我想坐公車去。公車站在我家{3}，坐公車{4}便宜又方便。

passage.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù yóujú jì liǎng fēng xìn, kěshì bù zhīdào zěnme zǒu. Wǒ xiān zài shǒujī shàng kàn dìtú, xiànzài wǒ zhīdào yóujú zài nǎlǐ le. Cóng wǒ jiā dào yóujú bù yuǎn, kěshì jīntiān tiānqì yǒudiǎn rè, wǒ xiǎng zuò gōngchē qù. Gōngchē zhàn zài wǒ jiā pángbiān, zuò gōngchē yòu piányí yòu fāngbiàn.
passage.english: I'm going to the post office to mail two letters, but I don't know how to get there. First I look at the map on my phone, and now I know where the post office is. It isn't far from my home to the post office, but it's a bit hot today, so I want to take the bus. The bus stop is next to my home, and the bus is both cheap and convenient.

questions.why: 封 counts letters: 兩封信 is two letters. 條 counts long things like roads.
了 at the end shows a change: before, the writer did not know the way; now the writer knows where the post office is.
在我家旁邊 means next to my home: the bus stop is right by the writer's home.
又 goes before each quality: 又便宜又方便 means both cheap and convenient.

passage.traditional: 今天我的日本朋友要來台灣找我。她的飛機下午兩點半到，我想在機場{1}她。我不{2}開車，可是沒問題，坐捷運{3}快又舒服。啊，現在一點半{4}！我要去捷運站。
passage.simplified: 今天我的日本朋友要来台湾找我。她的飞机下午两点半到，我想在机场{1}她。我不{2}开车，可是没问题，坐捷运{3}快又舒服。啊，现在一点半{4}！我要去捷运站。
passage.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ de Rìběn péngyǒu yào lái Táiwān zhǎo wǒ. Tā de fēijī xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn dào, wǒ xiǎng zài jīchǎng děng tā. Wǒ bú huì kāichē, kěshì méi wèntí, zuò jiéyùn yòu kuài yòu shūfu. A, xiànzài yì diǎn bàn le! Wǒ yào qù jiéyùn zhàn.
passage.english: Today my Japanese friend is coming to Taiwan to visit me. Her plane arrives at two thirty in the afternoon, and I want to wait for her at the airport. I can't drive, but that's no problem: the MRT is both fast and comfortable. Oh, it's one thirty now! I'm going to the MRT station.

questions.why: 等她 means wait for her: the writer will wait at the airport (在機場) for her plane.
不會開車 means cannot drive: driving is a skill you learn, so it takes 會.
又 goes before each quality: 又快又舒服 means both fast and comfortable.
了 at the end shows a new situation: it is one thirty now, so it is time to go.

prompt.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng hěn niánqīng, tā zài shūdiàn kàn zázhì.
prompt.english: That young man is reading a magazine in the bookstore.

choices.alt: A young man: a young man with short black hair reads a magazine by the bookstore shelf
An old man: an old man with grey hair reads a magazine by the bookstore shelf
A young woman: a young woman with long hair reads a magazine by the bookstore shelf

questions.why: 男生 is a young man and 年輕 means young. The old man is not 年輕, and 女生 would be a girl.

choices.english: Shoes are on the second floor.
The café is on the fourth floor.
Skirts are on the third floor.

questions.why: The guide says 3樓 裙子: skirts are on the third floor. Shoes are on 1樓, and the café is on 5樓.

prompt.traditional: 我想買一個新皮包，要到幾樓去？
prompt.simplified: 我想买一个新皮包，要到几楼去？
prompt.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí ge xīn píbāo, yào dào jǐ lóu qù?
prompt.english: I want to buy a new purse. Which floor should I go to?

questions.why: Purses are on 2樓, the second floor. The floors on either side sell other things: 1樓 has shoes and socks, and 3樓 has skirts.

choices.traditional: 黑色的鞋子一雙一千八百塊。

prompt.simplified: 一双白色的鞋子和两双袜子，一共多少钱？
prompt.pinyin: Yì shuāng báisè de xiézi hé liǎng shuāng wàzi, yígòng duōshǎo qián?
prompt.english: One pair of white shoes and two pairs of socks: how much altogether?

choices.pinyin: yì qiān liù bǎi èrshí kuài
yì qiān qī bǎi sìshí kuài

questions.why: White shoes are 1,500 and socks 120 a pair: 1,500 + 240 = 1,740. 1,620 has only one pair of socks; 2,040 uses the black shoes.

versions.alt: A department store clothing floor: Yiwen holds a long blue skirt up in front of a mirror while Yuanzhen smiles and gives a thumbs-up. Behind them are a rack of red, yellow, white and green skirts (none of them blue or black) and an open elevator. No bags, purses or phones are in the picture.

prompt.traditional: 這條藍色的裙子很好看，妳可以＿＿看。
prompt.simplified: 这条蓝色的裙子很好看，你可以＿＿看。

answer.traditional: 這條藍色的裙子很好看，妳可以穿穿看。
answer.simplified: 这条蓝色的裙子很好看，你可以穿穿看。
answer.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lánsè de qúnzi hěn hǎokàn, nǐ kěyǐ chuān chuan kàn.
answer.english: This blue skirt looks great. You can try it on and see.

questions.why: Verb + same verb + 看 means try it and see. She is already holding this skirt (這條), so she does not need to look for it (找找看): she can try it on, 穿穿看.

prompt.traditional: 這家百貨公司在捷運站旁邊，所以很＿＿找。
prompt.simplified: 这家百货公司在捷运站旁边，所以很＿＿找。

answer.traditional: 這家百貨公司在捷運站旁邊，所以很好找。
answer.simplified: 这家百货公司在捷运站旁边，所以很好找。
answer.pinyin: Zhè jiā bǎihuò gōngsī zài jiéyùn zhàn pángbiān, suǒyǐ hěn hǎo zhǎo.
answer.english: This department store is next to the MRT station, so it's easy to find.

questions.why: 好 + verb means easy to do: 好找, easy to find. 所以 makes it follow from being next to the MRT station (捷運站旁邊), so 難找 (hard to find) does not fit.

prompt.traditional: 我們從三樓走樓梯＿＿二樓去買皮包。
prompt.simplified: 我们从三楼走楼梯＿＿二楼去买皮包。

answer.traditional: 我們從三樓走樓梯到二樓去買皮包。
answer.simplified: 我们从三楼走楼梯到二楼去买皮包。
answer.pinyin: Wǒmen cóng sān lóu zǒu lóutī dào èr lóu qù mǎi píbāo.
answer.english: We're taking the stairs from the third floor to the second floor to buy a purse.

questions.why: 從 … 到 … gives a start and an end: from the third floor (從三樓), by the stairs, to the second floor (到二樓). 在 and 跟 cannot pair with 從 like this.

versions.alt: A department store clothing floor: Yiwen holds a long blue skirt up in front of a mirror while Yuanzhen smiles and gives a thumbs-up. Behind them are a rack of red, yellow, white and green skirts (none of them blue or black) and an open elevator. No bags, purses or phones are in the picture.

prompt.traditional: 這裡沒有黑色的裙子，我坐電梯去樓下＿＿看。
prompt.simplified: 这里没有黑色的裙子，我坐电梯去楼下＿＿看。

answer.traditional: 這裡沒有黑色的裙子，我坐電梯去樓下找找看。
answer.simplified: 这里没有黑色的裙子，我坐电梯去楼下找找看。
answer.pinyin: Zhèlǐ méiyǒu hēisè de qúnzi, wǒ zuò diàntī qù lóuxià zhǎo zhao kàn.
answer.english: There are no black skirts here. I'll take the elevator downstairs and try looking for one.

questions.why: 找找看 means look for it and see: there are no black skirts here, so the speaker goes downstairs to look for one. 吃吃看 (try eating) and 坐坐看 (try sitting) do not fit looking for a skirt.

prompt.traditional: 因為那條紅色的裙子很＿＿看，所以我不買。
prompt.simplified: 因为那条红色的裙子很＿＿看，所以我不买。

answer.traditional: 因為那條紅色的裙子很難看，所以我不買。
answer.simplified: 因为那条红色的裙子很难看，所以我不买。
answer.pinyin: Yīnwèi nà tiáo hóngsè de qúnzi hěn nánkàn, suǒyǐ wǒ bù mǎi.
answer.english: That red skirt doesn't look good, so I'm not buying it.

questions.why: 難 + a verb like 看 means unpleasant: 難看, not nice to look at, the opposite of 好看. 因為 … 所以我不買 needs a reason not to buy it, so 好看 does not fit, and 貴 cannot go before 看.

prompt.traditional: 這條很好看，我想＿＿媽媽一條。
prompt.simplified: 这条很好看，我想＿＿妈妈一条。

answer.traditional: 這條很好看，我想送媽媽一條。
answer.simplified: 这条很好看，我想送妈妈一条。
answer.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hěn hǎokàn, wǒ xiǎng sòng māma yì tiáo.
answer.english: This one looks great. I want to give Mom one.

questions.why: 送 + person + gift: 送媽媽一條 means give Mom one (a skirt). 找 and 穿 cannot take a person and a thing like this.

passage.traditional: 星期六晚上，我跟姐姐去百貨公司。藍色今年很{1}，所以姐姐想買一條藍色的裙子。有一條她很喜歡，可是她最近{2}了，所以那條裙子太小了。九點二十了，百貨公司{3}關門了，我們{4}電梯到一樓，回家了。
passage.simplified: 星期六晚上，我跟姐姐去百货公司。蓝色今年很{1}，所以姐姐想买一条蓝色的裙子。有一条她很喜欢，可是她最近{2}了，所以那条裙子太小了。九点二十了，百货公司{3}关门了，我们{4}电梯到一楼，回家了。
passage.pinyin: Xīngqíliù wǎnshàng, wǒ gēn jiějie qù bǎihuò gōngsī. Lánsè jīnnián hěn liúxíng, suǒyǐ jiějie xiǎng mǎi yì tiáo lánsè de qúnzi. Yǒu yì tiáo tā hěn xǐhuān, kěshì tā zuìjìn pàng le, suǒyǐ nà tiáo qúnzi tài xiǎo le. Jiǔ diǎn èrshí le, bǎihuò gōngsī kuàiyào guānmén le, wǒmen zuò diàntī dào yì lóu, huí jiā le.
passage.english: On Saturday evening my older sister and I went to the department store. Blue is very trendy this year, so my sister wanted a blue skirt. There was one she liked a lot, but she has put on weight lately, so that skirt was too small. It was 9:20 and the store was about to close. We took the elevator to the first floor and went home.

questions.why: 流行 means trendy: 藍色今年很流行, blue is very trendy this year. That is why she wants a blue skirt.
胖了 means she has put on weight, and 所以 says that is why the skirt is too small. 瘦了 (got thinner) would not make it too small.
快要 … 了 means something is about to happen: it is 9:20, and the store is about to close.
坐 is for riding in something: 坐電梯 means take the elevator.

passage.traditional: 我的鞋子都很{1}了，我想買一{2}新的。我的生日{3}到了，所以媽媽跟我去一家店買鞋子。那家店在我家{4}，我們走路去。店裡的鞋子很多，我最喜歡黑色的。
passage.simplified: 我的鞋子都很{1}了，我想买一{2}新的。我的生日{3}到了，所以妈妈跟我去一家店买鞋子。那家店在我家{4}，我们走路去。店里的鞋子很多，我最喜欢黑色的。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de xiézi dōu hěn jiù le, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng xīn de. Wǒ de shēngrì kuàiyào dào le, suǒyǐ māma gēn wǒ qù yì jiā diàn mǎi xiézi. Nà jiā diàn zài wǒ jiā fùjìn, wǒmen zǒulù qù. Diàn lǐ de xiézi hěn duō, wǒ zuì xǐhuān hēisè de.
passage.english: My shoes are all old now, so I want to buy a new pair. My birthday is coming soon, so Mom and I go to a shop to buy shoes. The shop is near my home, so we walk there. There are lots of shoes, and I like the black ones best.

questions.why: 舊 means old and worn: the writer's shoes are old, so the writer needs new ones (新的).
Shoes come in pairs, so they take 雙: 一雙新的. 條 is for skirts and pants.
快要 … 了 means something is about to happen: the writer's birthday is coming soon.
附近 means nearby: the shop is near the writer's home (在我家附近), so they walk there.

text.traditional:
哥哥：
我跟媽媽去超市買東西，晚上七點回家。弟弟在他的房間裡睡覺，爸爸在客廳看電視。
妹妹
text.simplified:
哥哥：
我跟妈妈去超市买东西，晚上七点回家。弟弟在他的房间里睡觉，爸爸在客厅看电视。
妹妹
text.pinyin: Gēge: Wǒ gēn māma qù chāoshì mǎi dōngxi, wǎnshàng qī diǎn huí jiā. Dìdi zài tā de fángjiān lǐ shuìjiào, bàba zài kètīng kàn diànshì. Mèimei
text.english: Big brother: Mom and I are going to the supermarket to buy some things; we'll be home at seven tonight. Our little brother is sleeping in his room, and Dad is watching TV in the living room. Your little sister

prompt.pinyin: Dìdi zài nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Where is the younger brother?

questions.why: She writes 弟弟在他的房間裡睡覺: the younger brother is sleeping in his room. Dad is the one in the living room (客廳), and the supermarket is where she and Mom are going.

text.traditional:
姐姐：
今天天氣有一點冷，我不去游泳了，下午想在家休息。晚上我們一起去看電影，好嗎？
弟弟

姐姐：
今天天气有一点冷，我不去游泳了，下午想在家休息。晚上我们一起去看电影，好吗？
弟弟
text.pinyin: Jiějie: Jīntiān tiānqì yǒu yìdiǎn lěng, wǒ bú qù yóuyǒng le, xiàwǔ xiǎng zài jiā xiūxí. Wǎnshàng wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng, hǎo ma? Dìdi
text.english: Big sister: It's a bit cold today, so I'm not going swimming after all; I want to rest at home this afternoon. Shall we go to a movie together tonight? Your little brother

prompt.traditional: 弟弟今天晚上想做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 弟弟今天晚上想做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Dìdi jīntiān wǎnshàng xiǎng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the younger brother want to do tonight?

questions.why: He won't swim today (不去游泳了) and rests at home in the afternoon (下午); 晚上 he wants to see a movie with her.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳在看書嗎？
lines.simplified: 你在看书吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zài kàn shū ma?
lines.english: Are you reading?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 沒有，我在寫作業。
lines.simplified: 没有，我在写作业。

lines.english: No, I'm doing my homework.

Homework: she writes in a notebook with a pencil
Reading: she reads a book, with no pencil or brush in her hand

questions.why: She says 沒有 to reading. 我在寫作業 means she is doing written homework right now.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳在做什麼？
lines.simplified: 你在做什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zài zuò shénme?
lines.english: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: F

lines.simplified: 我在看书，晚上再写功课。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài kàn shū, wǎnshàng zài xiě gōngkè.

choices.alt: Calligraphy: she writes on white paper with a writing brush
Homework: she writes in a notebook with a pencil
Reading: she reads a book, with no pencil or brush in her hand

questions.why: 我在看書 is what she is doing now. The homework comes later: 晚上再寫功課.

lines.traditional: 妳在寫功課嗎？
lines.simplified: 你在写功课吗？

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不是，我在寫書法。

choices.alt: Calligraphy: she writes on white paper with a writing brush
Homework: she writes in a notebook with a pencil

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你的毛筆不在書上面，在杯子裡面。
lines.simplified: 你的毛笔不在书上面，在杯子里面。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de máobǐ bú zài shū shàngmiàn, zài bēizi lǐmiàn.

On the book: the brush lies on top of the book
In the cup: the brush stands in the cup

questions.why: 不在書上面 rules out the book. 杯子裡面 means inside the cup: the brush stands in the cup.

lines.pinyin: Wǒ de máobǐ bú zài bēizi lǐ, zài shū hé bēizi zhōngjiān.
lines.english: My brush isn't in the cup. It's between the book and the cup.

choices.alt: Between: the brush lies on the desk between the book and the cup
On the book: the brush lies on top of the book
In the cup: the brush stands in the cup

questions.why: 不在杯子裡 rules out the cup. 中間 means between: the brush lies on the desk between the book and the cup, touching neither.

picture.alt: Daytime: bright sunlight, blue sky and green trees in the window behind them, no lamp on. A boy and a girl look at one open workbook. The boy frowns, points at one written sentence on the page and holds his head: he is puzzled by it. The girl holds a plain ballpoint pen over the page, her other hand on her chin. There is no computer, phone or tablet anywhere in the picture. Far behind them, through an open door into another room, writing brushes hang on a wooden stand; nobody holds a brush and there is no brush, ink or calligraphy paper on their table.

prompt.pinyin: Zhège xuéshēng xiǎng xué shénme?
prompt.english: What does this student want to learn?

questions.why: 我想學日文: the writer wants to learn Japanese. Chinese is what they can teach (可以教你中文), and they already speak English.

versions.alt: A calligraphy class in a classroom with a clean blackboard: at the front the teacher writes with a big writing brush to show the class, while a boy and a girl sit at their desks with brushes, ink and white paper and watch her before they practice.

answer.traditional: 我們用毛筆寫書法。
answer.simplified: 我们用毛笔写书法。
answer.pinyin: Wǒmen yòng máobǐ xiě shūfǎ.
answer.english: We write calligraphy with a brush.

questions.why: Calligraphy is written with a writing brush (毛筆), like the ones in the picture, not with a pencil or a computer.

answer.traditional: 書法課從兩點到四點。
answer.simplified: 书法课从两点到四点。
answer.pinyin: Shūfǎ kè cóng liǎng diǎn dào sì diǎn.
answer.english: Calligraphy class is from two to four.

questions.why: 從 … 到 … gives a span of time: from two until four. 和 joins two things, not a start and an end, and 再 means then.

answer.traditional: 我們在教室上書法課。
answer.simplified: 我们在教室上书法课。
answer.pinyin: Wǒmen zài jiàoshì shàng shūfǎ kè.
answer.english: We have calligraphy class in the classroom.

questions.why: The picture shows a classroom with a blackboard and desks, so the class is in the 教室. The dorm (宿舍) and the library (圖書館) are other places to study, not this room.

versions.alt: A calligraphy class in a classroom with a clean blackboard: at the front the teacher writes with a big writing brush to show the class, while a boy and a girl sit at their desks with brushes, ink and white paper and watch her before they practice.

prompt.traditional: 我只會寫這幾個字，＿＿字我都不會寫。
prompt.simplified: 我只会写这几个字，＿＿字我都不会写。

answer.traditional: 我只會寫這幾個字，別的字我都不會寫。
answer.simplified: 我只会写这几个字，别的字我都不会写。
answer.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ huì xiě zhè jǐ ge zì, biéde zì wǒ dōu bú huì xiě.
answer.english: I can only write these few characters; I can't write any other characters.

questions.why: 別的 + a noun means other: 別的字, the other characters. 別人 means other people, and 每 needs a measure word (每個字).

prompt.traditional: 你看，老師＿＿寫書法，我們先看。
prompt.simplified: 你看，老师＿＿写书法，我们先看。

answer.traditional: 你看，老師在寫書法，我們先看。
answer.simplified: 你看，老师在写书法，我们先看。
answer.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, lǎoshī zài xiě shūfǎ, wǒmen xiān kàn.
answer.english: Look, the teacher is writing calligraphy. Let's watch first.

questions.why: 在 before a verb says the action is happening now: the teacher is writing while the students watch (我們先看). 再 sounds the same but means then (later), and the picture shows her writing, so 不 (not) is wrong.

prompt.traditional: 我每天都練習，我的書法＿＿了。
prompt.simplified: 我每天都练习，我的书法＿＿了。

answer.traditional: 我每天都練習，我的書法進步了。
answer.simplified: 我每天都练习，我的书法进步了。
answer.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu liànxí, wǒ de shūfǎ jìnbù le.
answer.english: I practice every day, and my calligraphy has improved.

questions.why: 進步 means to improve: daily practice made her calligraphy better. 聰明 and 緊張 describe people, not calligraphy.

passage.traditional: 明天有華語考試，我有一點{1}。今天下午我{2}去圖書館寫作業，再回宿舍練習寫字。我的同學非常聰明，他寫字寫{3}又快又好看，{4}我常常問他字怎麼寫。希望明天的考試不難！
passage.simplified: 明天有华语考试，我有一点{1}。今天下午我{2}去图书馆写作业，再回宿舍练习写字。我的同学非常聪明，他写字写{3}又快又好看，{4}我常常问他字怎么写。希望明天的考试不难！
passage.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu Huáyǔ kǎoshì, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎn jǐnzhāng. Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ xiān qù túshūguǎn xiě zuòyè, zài huí sùshè liànxí xiě zì. Wǒ de tóngxué fēicháng cōngmíng, tā xiě zì xiě de yòu kuài yòu hǎokàn, suǒyǐ wǒ chángcháng wèn tā zì zěnme xiě. Xīwàng míngtiān de kǎoshì bù nán!
passage.english: There's a Chinese test tomorrow, and I'm a little nervous. This afternoon I'll go to the library first to do my homework, then go back to the dorm to practice writing characters. My classmate is very smart. He writes characters fast and neatly, so I often ask him how to write them. I hope tomorrow's test isn't hard!

bank.english: (links an action to how it is done)

questions.why: 有一點 goes with an unwelcome feeling: before a test you feel 緊張, nervous.
先 … 再 … puts two actions in order: the library first, then (再) back to the dorm.
得 joins an action to how it is done: 寫字寫得又快又好看.
所以 gives the result: he writes well, so I often ask him how to write characters.

passage.traditional: 我們{1}考試了。老師說我中文說得{2}好，可是寫字寫得很慢。我想請朋友教我寫字。他最近很忙，可是這個週末他{3}有空，我不知道。我不想問{4}，我想等他。我希望他能教我寫很多字。
passage.simplified: 我们{1}考试了。老师说我中文说得{2}好，可是写字写得很慢。我想请朋友教我写字。他最近很忙，可是这个周末他{3}有空，我不知道。我不想问{4}，我想等他。我希望他能教我写很多字。
passage.pinyin: Wǒmen kuàiyào kǎoshì le. Lǎoshī shuō wǒ Zhōngwén shuō de fēicháng hǎo, kěshì xiě zì xiě de hěn màn. Wǒ xiǎng qǐng péngyǒu jiāo wǒ xiě zì. Tā zuìjìn hěn máng, kěshì zhège zhōumò tā yěxǔ yǒu kòng, wǒ bù zhīdào. Wǒ bù xiǎng wèn biérén, wǒ xiǎng děng tā. Wǒ xīwàng tā néng jiāo wǒ xiě hěn duō zì.
passage.english: We're about to have a test. My teacher says I speak Chinese very well, but I write characters slowly. I want to ask a friend to teach me to write characters. He's busy lately, but maybe he's free this weekend; I don't know. I don't want to ask anyone else; I'll wait for him. I hope he can teach me to write lots of characters.

questions.why: 快要 … 了 means something is about to happen: the test is coming soon.
非常 means very and goes between 得 and 好: the teacher says the speaking is very good, but (可是) the writing is slow.
也許 means maybe, and 我不知道 shows the writer is not sure: 這個週末他也許有空. 非常 cannot describe something you don't know, and 常常 (often) does not fit one weekend.
別人 means other people: the writer does not want to ask anyone else, so they wait for the friend.

text.traditional:

禮拜三我們去機場看飛機吧！坐計程車太貴了，我們坐捷運去。九點我在捷運站等你。
國安

国安

text.english: Zhongming: Let's go to the airport on Wednesday and watch the planes! A taxi is too expensive, so we'll take the MRT. I'll wait for you at the MRT station at nine. Guoan

妳網球打得很好，禮拜六上午我們一起去打網球，好嗎？下午我要去游泳，晚上我們一起吃飯吧！

questions.why: 多 before a verb means do it more: 多運動, exercise more. 少玩手機 is what he should do less.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我感冒了，不想吃麵，想吃水果。
lines.simplified: 我感冒了，不想吃面，想吃水果。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, bù xiǎng chī miàn, xiǎng chī shuǐguǒ.
lines.english: I have a cold. I don't want noodles. I want some fruit.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那少吃香蕉，多吃一點蘋果吧。
lines.simplified: 那少吃香蕉，多吃一点苹果吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà shǎo chī xiāngjiāo, duō chī yìdiǎn píngguǒ ba.
lines.english: Then eat fewer bananas and a few more apples.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說女的應該多吃什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的说女的应该多吃什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō nǚ de yīnggāi duō chī shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man say the woman should eat more of?

questions.why: 多吃一點蘋果 means eat a few more apples. Bananas are what he says to eat less of (少吃香蕉), and noodles are what she does not want (不想吃麵).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你會做飯嗎？
lines.simplified: 你会做饭吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ huì zuòfàn ma?
lines.english: Can you cook?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 會，可是我做得很慢，我哥哥做得比較快。
lines.simplified: 会，可是我做得很慢，我哥哥做得比较快。
lines.pinyin: Huì, kěshì wǒ zuò de hěn màn, wǒ gēge zuò de bǐjiào kuài.
lines.english: Yes, but I cook very slowly. My older brother cooks faster.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuòfàn zuò de zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How does the man cook?

questions.why: He can cook, but 我做得很慢: he cooks slowly. 比較快 is about his older brother, not him.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳英文歌唱得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 你英文歌唱得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ Yīngwén gē chàng de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: How well do you sing English songs?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 唱得不好，我中文歌唱得比較好。
lines.simplified: 唱得不好，我中文歌唱得比较好。
lines.pinyin: Chàng de bù hǎo, wǒ Zhōngwén gē chàng de bǐjiào hǎo.
lines.english: Not well. I sing Chinese songs better.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的什麼歌唱得比較好？
prompt.simplified: 女的什么歌唱得比较好？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shénme gē chàng de bǐjiào hǎo?
prompt.english: Which songs does the woman sing better?

questions.why: She sings English songs 不好 (not well); 中文歌唱得比較好: she sings Chinese songs better. Japanese songs never come up.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 從學校到醫院，我們坐公車去，還是坐捷運去？
lines.simplified: 从学校到医院，我们坐公车去，还是坐捷运去？

lines.english: From school to the hospital, shall we take the bus or the MRT?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 坐公車又慢又不舒服，坐捷運又快又方便。
lines.simplified: 坐公车又慢又不舒服，坐捷运又快又方便。
lines.pinyin: Zuò gōngchē yòu màn yòu bù shūfu, zuò jiéyùn yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn.
lines.english: The bus is slow and uncomfortable. The MRT is fast and convenient.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得坐捷運怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得坐捷运怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde zuò jiéyùn zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the woman think of taking the MRT?

questions.why: She says 坐捷運又快又方便: the MRT is fast and convenient. 又慢又不舒服 is what she says about the bus, and she never says the MRT is cheap (便宜).

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳晚上怎麼回家？騎腳踏車嗎？
lines.simplified: 你晚上怎么回家？骑脚踏车吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ wǎnshàng zěnme huí jiā? Qí jiǎotàchē ma?

lines.english: No. It will be very cold tonight, so I'm taking a taxi home.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wǎnshàng yào zěnme huí jiā?
prompt.english: How will the woman get home tonight?

questions.why: She says 不騎了 (no bike), then 我要坐計程車回家: she will take a taxi home. 很冷 is only her reason.

prompt.traditional: 戴口罩的是男生，女生沒戴。

Only the girl in a mask: two students with school backpacks; the girl wears a face mask, the boy does not
Both in masks: two students with school backpacks; the boy and the girl both wear face masks

questions.why: 戴口罩的 is "the one wearing a mask": that is the boy (男生), and the girl does not wear one (女生沒戴).

Only the girl in a mask: two students with school backpacks; the girl wears a face mask, the boy does not

Washing his face: the little boy splashes water on his face; his hair is dry
Washing his hair: the little boy has shampoo foam in his hair; his face is dry

Washing his face: the little boy splashes water on his face; his hair is dry
Washing his hair: the little boy has shampoo foam in his hair; his face is dry

transcript.traditional: 注意！　最近很多同學感冒了　請常常洗手　如果咳嗽，就要戴口罩　如果頭痛，就去看醫生　如果發燒了，就跟老師請假，在家多休息

transcript.pinyin: Zhùyì! Zuìjìn hěn duō tóngxué gǎnmào le. Qǐng chángcháng xǐ shǒu. Rúguǒ késòu, jiù yào dài kǒuzhào. Rúguǒ tóu tòng, jiù qù kàn yīshēng. Rúguǒ fāshāo le, jiù gēn lǎoshī qǐngjià, zài jiā duō xiūxí.

prompt.pinyin: Késòu de xuéshēng yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What should a student with a cough do?

questions.why: The notice says 如果咳嗽，就要戴口罩: a cough means a mask. Seeing a doctor is for a headache, and asking for leave is for a fever.

choices.simplified: 咳嗽的学生要跟老师请假。
choices.pinyin: Késòu de xuéshēng yào gēn lǎoshī qǐngjià.

choices.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ xiàwǔ kěyǐ qù kàn yīshēng.

choices.traditional: 星期天上午可以去看醫生。
choices.simplified: 星期天上午可以去看医生。
choices.pinyin: Xīngqítiān shàngwǔ kěyǐ qù kàn yīshēng.
choices.english: You can see a doctor on Sunday morning.

questions.why: Monday to Friday (星期一到星期五) the hospital is open 2:00–5:00 in the afternoon, so Friday afternoon works. On Saturday only the morning is open, and 星期天休息 means it is closed on Sunday.

prompt.traditional: 星期六幾點可以去看醫生？
prompt.simplified: 星期六几点可以去看医生？
prompt.pinyin: Xīngqíliù jǐ diǎn kěyǐ qù kàn yīshēng?
prompt.english: On Saturday, at what time can you see a doctor?

questions.why: On Saturday the sign shows only 上午 9:00–12:00, so ten in the morning works. The afternoon hours are for Monday to Friday, and it is never open in the evening.

versions.alt: A clinic waiting room: a worried mother holds her small son, who holds his belly; a young man in a face mask and glasses stands away from the desk, bent a little forward, coughing (small cough lines at his mask) with one hand flat on his chest and the other arm at his side, sleeves pushed up, both bare wrists in plain view; a doctor sits at the desk with a glass of water on it. Only the young man wears a mask: the mother, the boy and the doctor wear none. Nobody wears a watch.

answer.traditional: 戴口罩的男生在咳嗽。
answer.simplified: 戴口罩的男生在咳嗽。
answer.pinyin: Dài kǒuzhào de nánshēng zài késòu.
answer.english: The young man in the mask is coughing.

questions.why: 戴口罩的男生 is the young man in the mask, and the picture shows him coughing (咳嗽). The water glass is on the doctor's desk, and nobody is washing their hands.

prompt.traditional: 那個肚子痛的孩子要多休息，明天就＿＿好了。
prompt.simplified: 那个肚子痛的孩子要多休息，明天就＿＿好了。

answer.traditional: 那個肚子痛的孩子要多休息，明天就會好了。
answer.simplified: 那个肚子痛的孩子要多休息，明天就会好了。
answer.pinyin: Nàge dùzi tòng de háizi yào duō xiūxí, míngtiān jiù huì hǎo le.
answer.english: The child with the sore belly needs to rest more. Then he will be well again tomorrow.

questions.why: 明天 points to the future, and 會 means will: 明天就會好了, the boy holding his belly will be well (好了) tomorrow. 在 (in the middle of doing) and 想 (to want) do not fit before 好了 here.

prompt.traditional: 醫生跟那個孩子說：「如果你肚子痛，＿＿要少吃一點。」
prompt.simplified: 医生跟那个孩子说：「如果你肚子痛，＿＿要少吃一点。」

answer.traditional: 醫生跟那個孩子說：「如果你肚子痛，就要少吃一點。」
answer.simplified: 医生跟那个孩子说：「如果你肚子痛，就要少吃一点。」
answer.pinyin: Yīshēng gēn nàge háizi shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ dùzi tòng, jiù yào shǎo chī yìdiǎn.”
answer.english: The doctor tells the child, “If your belly hurts, you should eat a little less.”

questions.why: 如果 opens the condition and 就 starts the result: 如果……，就……. 所以 goes with 因為, not 如果, and 可是 (but) does not fit the doctor's advice for a sore belly.

versions.alt: A clinic waiting room: a worried mother holds her small son, who holds his belly; a young man in a face mask and glasses stands away from the desk, bent a little forward, coughing (small cough lines at his mask) with one hand flat on his chest and the other arm at his side, sleeves pushed up, both bare wrists in plain view; a doctor sits at the desk with a glass of water on it. Only the young man wears a mask: the mother, the boy and the doctor wear none. Nobody wears a watch.

prompt.traditional: 那個孩子肚子痛，他媽媽很＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 那个孩子肚子痛，他妈妈很＿＿。

answer.traditional: 那個孩子肚子痛，他媽媽很擔心。
answer.simplified: 那个孩子肚子痛，他妈妈很担心。
answer.pinyin: Nàge háizi dùzi tòng, tā māma hěn dānxīn.
answer.english: That child's belly hurts, and his mother is very worried.

questions.why: Her child's belly hurts, so the mother is worried: 很擔心. In the picture she looks worried, not glad (高興), and 舒服 (comfortable) does not fit a mother whose child is sick.

answer.traditional: 那個男生戴口罩，也戴眼鏡。
answer.simplified: 那个男生戴口罩，也戴眼镜。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng dài kǒuzhào, yě dài yǎnjìng.
answer.english: That young man wears a mask and glasses too.

questions.why: He wears glasses (眼鏡), not a watch; 眼睛 looks alike but means eyes.

prompt.traditional: 醫生跟那個咳嗽的男生說：「你要＿＿多喝水。」
prompt.simplified: 医生跟那个咳嗽的男生说：「你要＿＿多喝水。」

answer.traditional: 醫生跟那個咳嗽的男生說：「你要記得多喝水。」
answer.simplified: 医生跟那个咳嗽的男生说：「你要记得多喝水。」
answer.pinyin: Yīshēng gēn nàge késòu de nánshēng shuō: “Nǐ yào jìde duō hē shuǐ.”
answer.english: The doctor tells the coughing young man, “You must remember to drink more water.”

questions.why: 記得 + an action means remember to do it: 要記得多喝水, remember to drink more water. 覺得 (to think) and 告訴 (to tell) cannot come right before an action like this; 告訴 needs a person (告訴你……).

passage.traditional: {1}我發燒了，所以今天不能去上課。我打電話{2}老師請假，媽媽帶我去看醫生。醫生說我要{3}休息，少上網。{4}明天好了，我就會去學校上課。
passage.simplified: {1}我发烧了，所以今天不能去上课。我打电话{2}老师请假，妈妈带我去看医生。医生说我要{3}休息，少上网。{4}明天好了，我就会去学校上课。
passage.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ fāshāo le, suǒyǐ jīntiān bù néng qù shàngkè. Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gēn lǎoshī qǐngjià, māma dài wǒ qù kàn yīshēng. Yīshēng shuō wǒ yào duō xiūxí, shǎo shàngwǎng. Rúguǒ míngtiān hǎo le, wǒ jiù huì qù xuéxiào shàngkè.
passage.english: Because I have a fever, I can't go to class today. I call my teacher to ask for leave, and Mom takes me to see a doctor. The doctor says I should rest more and go online less. If I'm better tomorrow, I'll go to school.

questions.why: 所以 (so) in the same sentence needs 因為 (because) before the reason: 因為我發燒了，所以…….
跟 comes before the person you speak to: 跟老師請假, ask the teacher for leave.
多 before a verb gives advice: 多休息 (rest more) pairs with 少上網 (go online less). 少休息 would be wrong advice for a fever.
如果 opens the condition, and 就 starts the result: 如果明天好了，我就會去.

passage.traditional: 我的朋友{1}了，很不舒服。我打電話{2}她說，要多喝水、多休息。她說她明天不{3}來上課。今天下午我想{4}去超市買一些水果，再去她家看她。

passage.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu gǎnmào le, hěn bù shūfu. Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gēn tā shuō, yào duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí. Tā shuō tā míngtiān bú huì lái shàngkè. Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ xiǎng xiān qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē shuǐguǒ, zài qù tā jiā kàn tā.
passage.english: My friend has caught a cold and doesn't feel well. I called her and told her to drink more water and rest more. She said she won't come to class tomorrow. This afternoon I want to go to the supermarket first to buy some fruit, then go to her home to see her.

questions.why: 了 after the blank and 很不舒服 show she is sick: 感冒了, she has caught a cold. 健康 (healthy) does not fit someone who feels unwell.
跟 comes before the person you speak to: 我打電話跟她說, I called and told her.
不會 means will not: 明天不會來上課, she won't come to class tomorrow.
先 goes with the 再 that follows: 先去超市……，再去她家, first the supermarket, then her home.

lines.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: What do you think of this movie?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 很有趣，可是有一點長。
lines.simplified: 很有趣，可是有一点长。
lines.pinyin: Hěn yǒuqù, kěshì yǒu yìdiǎn cháng.
lines.english: It's very interesting, but a bit long.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得這部電影怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得这部电影怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde zhè bù diànyǐng zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the woman think of the movie?

questions.why: 有一點長 means a bit long, so 有一點短 (a bit short) is wrong. She says 很有趣, so 不太有趣 is wrong too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們快要上課了，你在哪裡？
lines.simplified: 我们快要上课了，你在哪里？
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen kuàiyào shàngkè le, nǐ zài nǎlǐ?
lines.english: Class is about to start. Where are you?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我在電梯裡，快要到了。
lines.simplified: 我在电梯里，快要到了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài diàntī lǐ, kuàiyào dào le.
lines.english: I'm in the elevator. I'm almost there.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xiànzài zài nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Where is the man now?

questions.why: 我在電梯裡 means he is in the elevator. 快要到了: he is almost there, so he is not in the classroom yet.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我要寄信，這附近有郵局嗎？
lines.simplified: 我要寄信，这附近有邮局吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào jì xìn, zhè fùjìn yǒu yóujú ma?
lines.english: I want to mail a letter. Is there a post office near here?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 有，超市對面有一間郵局。
lines.simplified: 有，超市对面有一间邮局。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, chāoshì duìmiàn yǒu yì jiān yóujú.
lines.english: Yes, there's a post office across from the supermarket.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Yóujú zài nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Where is the post office?

questions.why: 超市對面 means across from the supermarket. 旁邊 would be next to it, and she does not talk about a school.

versions.alt: A phone screen showing a family group chat named 家人. Mom (12:10) suggests going out to eat together this Sunday evening; the older brother (12:30) says yes, he is free in the evening; the younger sister (18:45) says a classmate asked her to a movie on Sunday evening and she has not decided yet; Mom (18:50) says that's okay, tell her once she has decided

transcript.traditional: 家人　媽媽 12:10：這個星期天晚上，我們一起去外面吃飯，好嗎？　哥哥 12:30：好啊！我晚上有空。　妹妹 18:45：同學約我星期天晚上看電影，我還沒決定。　媽媽 18:50：沒關係，妳決定了再告訴我。
transcript.simplified: 家人　妈妈 12:10：这个星期天晚上，我们一起去外面吃饭，好吗？　哥哥 12:30：好啊！我晚上有空。　妹妹 18:45：同学约我星期天晚上看电影，我还没决定。　妈妈 18:50：没关系，你决定了再告诉我。
transcript.pinyin: Jiārén. Māma 12:10: Zhège xīngqítiān wǎnshàng, wǒmen yìqǐ qù wàimiàn chī fàn, hǎo ma? Gēge 12:30: Hǎo a! Wǒ wǎnshàng yǒu kòng. Mèimei 18:45: Tóngxué yuē wǒ xīngqítiān wǎnshàng kàn diànyǐng, wǒ hái méi juédìng. Māma 18:50: Méiguānxi, nǐ juédìng le zài gàosu wǒ.
transcript.english: Family. Mom 12:10: This Sunday evening, shall we all go out to eat together? Big brother 12:30: Sure! I'm free in the evening. Little sister 18:45: A classmate asked me to see a movie on Sunday evening. I haven't decided yet. Mom 18:50: That's okay. Tell me when you've decided.

prompt.pinyin: Nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which one is true?

choices.english: Mom hasn't left a message yet.

questions.why: 妹妹 writes 我還沒決定: she has not decided yet. 哥哥 has already answered (好啊！), and 媽媽 has left two messages.

versions.alt: A café in the afternoon. Left: a young woman with very long hair sits alone and holds a camera up to take a photo of the small cake and cup of coffee on her table; she has no phone or laptop. Middle: a young man and a young woman with very short hair sit across from each other, talking and laughing; they each have a coffee cup (his is empty, and he is not holding it), with nothing to eat and no menu, phone or laptop on their table. Right: a clerk has stepped out from the counter (a glass case of small cakes) and walks toward the middle table with a tray of two small cakes; she has not reached it yet

prompt.traditional: 那個頭髮很長的女生點＿＿一個小蛋糕和一杯咖啡。
prompt.simplified: 那个头发很长的女生点＿＿一个小蛋糕和一杯咖啡。

answer.traditional: 那個頭髮很長的女生點了一個小蛋糕和一杯咖啡。
answer.simplified: 那个头发很长的女生点了一个小蛋糕和一杯咖啡。
answer.pinyin: Nàge tóufǎ hěn cháng de nǚshēng diǎn le yí ge xiǎo dàngāo hé yì bēi kāfēi.
answer.english: The girl with long hair ordered a small cake and a cup of coffee.

questions.why: 了 after the verb shows the ordering is done: 點了一個小蛋糕. 得 and 的 cannot follow 點 here.

answer.traditional: 她先照相，再吃蛋糕。
answer.simplified: 她先照相，再吃蛋糕。
answer.pinyin: Tā xiān zhàoxiàng, zài chī dàngāo.
answer.english: She takes a photo first, and then she eats the cake.

questions.why: She holds a camera up to her cake, so she 照相 first. She sits alone, so she is not 聊天, and she has no phone or laptop, so she is not 上網.

prompt.traditional: 這家咖啡廳的蛋糕又好看＿＿好吃。
prompt.simplified: 这家咖啡厅的蛋糕又好看＿＿好吃。

answer.traditional: 這家咖啡廳的蛋糕又好看又好吃。
answer.simplified: 这家咖啡厅的蛋糕又好看又好吃。
answer.pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēitīng de dàngāo yòu hǎokàn yòu hǎochī.
answer.english: This café's cakes are both pretty and tasty.

questions.why: 又 … 又 … comes in a pair: 又好看又好吃 means both pretty and tasty. 和 joins nouns, not describing words, and 都 cannot follow 又好看.

answer.traditional: 那個男生喝了一杯咖啡。
answer.simplified: 那个男生喝了一杯咖啡。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng hē le yì bēi kāfēi.
answer.english: The young man has drunk a cup of coffee.

questions.why: His cup is empty, so he 喝了一杯 (has drunk a cup: 了 = done). He is not holding the empty cup, so he is not 在喝 (drinking now), and he has a cup, so he did order (not 還沒點).

prompt.traditional: 那兩個人點的蛋糕＿＿，他們的桌子上只有咖啡。
prompt.simplified: 那两个人点的蛋糕＿＿，他们的桌子上只有咖啡。

answer.traditional: 那兩個人點的蛋糕還沒來，他們的桌子上只有咖啡。
answer.simplified: 那两个人点的蛋糕还没来，他们的桌子上只有咖啡。
answer.pinyin: Nà liǎng ge rén diǎn de dàngāo hái méi lái, tāmen de zhuōzi shàng zhǐ yǒu kāfēi.
answer.english: The cakes those two ordered haven't come yet; there's only coffee on their table.

questions.why: The clerk is still carrying their cakes over, and their table has only coffee, so the cake 還沒來 (has not come yet). It is not on their table (not 已經來了), and they have not eaten it, so they cannot know it is 很好吃.

prompt.traditional: 那兩個人在＿＿，他們很開心。
prompt.simplified: 那两个人在＿＿，他们很开心。

answer.traditional: 那兩個人在聊天，他們很開心。
answer.simplified: 那两个人在聊天，他们很开心。
answer.pinyin: Nà liǎng ge rén zài liáotiān, tāmen hěn kāixīn.
answer.english: Those two are chatting, and they are very happy.

questions.why: Look at the two people at the middle table: they talk and laugh (聊天). They have no computer or phone out, and no menu, so they are not going online or ordering.

passage.traditional: 上個月是我的生日，爸爸給我買{1}一台照相機。這個週末，我打算跟朋友去市場照相，那裡的東西很多，也很{2}。朋友說：「中午市場的人太多了，我們先去吃午飯，{3}下午人少了，我們{4}去吧。」
passage.simplified: 上个月是我的生日，爸爸给我买{1}一台照相机。这个周末，我打算跟朋友去市场照相，那里的东西很多，也很{2}。朋友说：「中午市场的人太多了，我们先去吃午饭，{3}下午人少了，我们{4}去吧。」
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè shì wǒ de shēngrì, bàba gěi wǒ mǎi le yì tái zhàoxiàngjī. Zhège zhōumò, wǒ dǎsuàn gēn péngyǒu qù shìchǎng zhàoxiàng, nàlǐ de dōngxi hěn duō, yě hěn yǒuqù. Péngyǒu shuō: “Zhōngwǔ shìchǎng de rén tài duō le, wǒmen xiān qù chī wǔfàn, děng xiàwǔ rén shǎo le, wǒmen zài qù ba.”
passage.english: Last month was my birthday, and Dad bought me a camera. This weekend I plan to go and take photos at the market with a friend; there are lots of interesting things there. My friend said, "The market is too crowded at noon. Let's have lunch first, and when there are fewer people in the afternoon, we'll go."

questions.why: 了 after the verb shows the buying is done: 爸爸給我買了一台照相機, Dad bought me a camera.
很 needs a describing word: 很有趣, very interesting. 機會 is a noun.
等 + something happens: 等下午人少了 means once there are fewer people in the afternoon.
再 marks the next step after 等: 等下午人少了，我們再去.

passage.traditional: 我在網路上認識了一個韓國女生，我們{1}每天晚上都上網聊天。她說下個月要來台灣{2}我玩。我想先買一張台灣的地圖，{3}她來了，我們{4}一起去很多地方。
passage.simplified: 我在网路上认识了一个韩国女生，我们{1}每天晚上都上网聊天。她说下个月要来台湾{2}我玩。我想先买一张台湾的地图，{3}她来了，我们{4}一起去很多地方。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ zài wǎnglù shàng rènshì le yí ge Hánguó nǚshēng, wǒmen chàbùduō měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu shàngwǎng liáotiān. Tā shuō xià ge yuè yào lái Táiwān zhǎo wǒ wán. Wǒ xiǎng xiān mǎi yì zhāng Táiwān de dìtú, děng tā lái le, wǒmen zài yìqǐ qù hěn duō dìfāng.
passage.english: I got to know a Korean girl online, and we chat online almost every night. She says she will come to Taiwan to visit me next month. I want to buy a map of Taiwan first; when she comes, we will go to lots of places together.

questions.why: 差不多每天晚上 means almost every night.
來 + place + 找 + person: 來台灣找我玩 means come to Taiwan to visit me. 等我玩 makes no sense here.
等她來了 means once she has come: 等 marks what we wait for.
再 marks the step after 等: 等她來了，我們再一起去.

text.traditional:
哥哥：
我感冒了，有一點發燒，今天不去上課了。等你下課了，可以幫我買一些藥嗎？醫生說我要多喝水、多休息。
妹妹
text.simplified:
哥哥：

versions.alt: A hot summer morning in an office. A large wall clock shows 9:20. A young man in a white shirt and blue tie hurries in through the door with his bag, sweating; the boss, an older man in a black suit, stands by the door and speaks to him. Inside, a young woman works at a computer with a mug of hot coffee beside it. An air conditioner on the wall blows cool air; through the window the sun is blazing.

prompt.traditional: 那個男生九點上班，今天＿＿了二十分鐘。
prompt.simplified: 那个男生九点上班，今天＿＿了二十分钟。
prompt.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng jiǔ diǎn shàngbān, jīntiān ＿＿ le èrshí fēnzhōng.
prompt.english: That young man starts work at nine; today he was ＿＿ by twenty minutes.

answer.traditional: 那個男生九點上班，今天遲到了二十分鐘。
answer.simplified: 那个男生九点上班，今天迟到了二十分钟。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng jiǔ diǎn shàngbān, jīntiān chídào le èrshí fēnzhōng.
answer.english: That young man starts work at nine; today he was twenty minutes late.

questions.why: The clock shows 9:20 and he starts at nine, so he is twenty minutes late: 遲到了二十分鐘. 準時 (on time) cannot take 二十分鐘 after it.

prompt.traditional: 那個女生覺得這個工作很好：辦公室裡有冷氣，＿＿休息的時候還可以喝咖啡。

prompt.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng juéde zhège gōngzuò hěn hǎo: bàngōngshì lǐ yǒu lěngqì, ＿＿ xiūxí de shíhòu hái kěyǐ hē kāfēi.
prompt.english: That young woman thinks this job is good: the office has air conditioning, ＿＿ she can drink coffee on her breaks.

answer.traditional: 那個女生覺得這個工作很好：辦公室裡有冷氣，而且休息的時候還可以喝咖啡。
answer.simplified: 那个女生觉得这个工作很好：办公室里有冷气，而且休息的时候还可以喝咖啡。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng juéde zhège gōngzuò hěn hǎo: bàngōngshì lǐ yǒu lěngqì, érqiě xiūxí de shíhòu hái kěyǐ hē kāfēi.
answer.english: That young woman thinks this job is good: the office has air conditioning, and on top of that she can drink coffee on her breaks.

questions.why: 而且 adds one more good point: the office has air conditioning, and on top of that (還) she can drink coffee on her breaks. 所以 (so) and 可是 (but) do not join two good points.

prompt.traditional: 老闆＿＿那個男生說：「明天要準時！」
prompt.simplified: 老板＿＿那个男生说：「明天要准时！」
prompt.pinyin: Lǎobǎn ＿＿ nàge nánshēng shuō: "Míngtiān yào zhǔnshí!"
prompt.english: The boss says ＿＿ that young man: "Be on time tomorrow!"

answer.traditional: 老闆對那個男生說：「明天要準時！」
answer.simplified: 老板对那个男生说：「明天要准时！」
answer.pinyin: Lǎobǎn duì nàge nánshēng shuō: "Míngtiān yào zhǔnshí!"
answer.english: The boss says to that young man: "Be on time tomorrow!"

questions.why: 對 + person + 說 means to say something to someone: 老闆對那個男生說. 用 needs a tool, and 從 needs a starting place.

versions.alt: A hot summer morning in an office. A large wall clock shows 9:20. A young man in a white shirt and blue tie hurries in through the door with his bag, sweating; the boss, an older man in a black suit, stands by the door and speaks to him. Inside, a young woman works at a computer with a mug of hot coffee beside it. An air conditioner on the wall blows cool air; through the window the sun is blazing.

prompt.traditional: 穿黑衣服的先生是那個男生的＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 穿黑衣服的先生是那个男生的＿＿。
prompt.pinyin: Chuān hēi yīfu de xiānshēng shì nàge nánshēng de ＿＿.
prompt.english: The man in black is that young man's ＿＿.

answer.traditional: 穿黑衣服的先生是那個男生的老闆。
answer.simplified: 穿黑衣服的先生是那个男生的老板。
answer.pinyin: Chuān hēi yīfu de xiānshēng shì nàge nánshēng de lǎobǎn.
answer.english: The man in black is that young man's boss.

questions.why: The older man in the black suit stands at the door and speaks seriously to the late young man: he is his boss (老闆). This is an office, not a school, so he is not his teacher (老師) or classmate (同學).

prompt.traditional: 外面很熱，可是辦公室裡有＿＿，很舒服。
prompt.simplified: 外面很热，可是办公室里有＿＿，很舒服。
prompt.pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn rè, kěshì bàngōngshì lǐ yǒu ＿＿, hěn shūfu.
prompt.english: It's hot outside, but the office has ＿＿, so it's comfortable.

answer.traditional: 外面很熱，可是辦公室裡有冷氣，很舒服。
answer.simplified: 外面很热，可是办公室里有冷气，很舒服。
answer.pinyin: Wàimiàn hěn rè, kěshì bàngōngshì lǐ yǒu lěngqì, hěn shūfu.
answer.english: It's hot outside, but the office has air conditioning, so it's comfortable.

questions.why: It is hot outside, but (可是) the office is comfortable because of the air conditioner on the wall: 冷氣. A computer does not cool a room, and the window only shows the hot sun outside.

prompt.traditional: 那個男生＿＿上班都很準時，可是今天遲到了。
prompt.simplified: 那个男生＿＿上班都很准时，可是今天迟到了。
prompt.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng ＿＿ shàngbān dōu hěn zhǔnshí, kěshì jīntiān chídào le.
prompt.english: That young man ＿＿ was always on time for work, but today he is late.

answer.traditional: 那個男生以前上班都很準時，可是今天遲到了。
answer.simplified: 那个男生以前上班都很准时，可是今天迟到了。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng yǐqián shàngbān dōu hěn zhǔnshí, kěshì jīntiān chídào le.
answer.english: That young man was always on time for work before, but today he is late.

questions.why: 以前 means before, in the past: he was always on time before, but (可是) today he is late. 以後 and 明天 point to the future, so they cannot be set against what happened today.

passage.traditional: 我哥哥今年畢業以後，就在一家公司上班了。他以前沒工作{1}，所以現在覺得工作很{2}。他每天都走路去公司，還{3}遲到過。他說，走路{4}身體很好。
passage.simplified: 我哥哥今年毕业以后，就在一家公司上班了。他以前没工作{1}，所以现在觉得工作很{2}。他每天都走路去公司，还{3}迟到过。他说，走路{4}身体很好。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ gēge jīnnián bìyè yǐhòu, jiù zài yì jiā gōngsī shàngbān le. Tā yǐqián méi gōngzuò guo, suǒyǐ xiànzài juéde gōngzuò hěn xīnkǔ. Tā měi tiān dōu zǒulù qù gōngsī, hái méi chídào guo. Tā shuō, zǒulù duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
passage.english: After my older brother graduated this year, he started working at a company. He had never worked before, so now he finds work hard. He walks to work every day and hasn't been late yet. He says walking is very good for your health.

questions.why: 沒 + verb + 過 says something has never happened: 沒工作過, he had never worked before.
很 needs a describing word after it: 工作很辛苦, work is hard. He had never worked before, so now (現在) he finds it hard.
還沒 + verb + 過 says something has not happened yet: 還沒遲到過, he hasn't been late yet. 過 is already there, so the blank needs 沒.
對 points to who or what something is good for: 走路對身體很好, walking is good for your body.

passage.traditional: 我妹妹想當記者。她說，記者的工作很{1}，可以去很多地方。她去{2}日本和美國，也會{3}英文跟別人聊天。她的英文老師也{4}她說：「妳以後一定能當一個好記者！」
passage.simplified: 我妹妹想当记者。她说，记者的工作很{1}，可以去很多地方。她去{2}日本和美国，也会{3}英文跟别人聊天。她的英文老师也{4}她说：「你以后一定能当一个好记者！」
passage.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei xiǎng dāng jìzhě. Tā shuō, jìzhě de gōngzuò hěn yǒuqù, kěyǐ qù hěn duō dìfāng. Tā qù guo Rìběn hé Měiguó, yě huì yòng Yīngwén gēn biérén liáotiān. Tā de Yīngwén lǎoshī yě duì tā shuō: "Nǐ yǐhòu yídìng néng dāng yí ge hǎo jìzhě!"
passage.english: My younger sister wants to be a reporter. She says a reporter's job is interesting, and you can go to lots of places. She has been to Japan and the US, and she can chat with people in English. Her English teacher also says to her: "You'll surely be a good reporter one day!"

questions.why: 很 needs a describing word after it: the job is 有趣 (interesting), since you can go to many places.
過 right after a verb marks an experience: 去過日本和美國, she has been to Japan and the US.
用 comes before the language you use: 用英文跟別人聊天, chat with people in English.
對 + person + 說 means to say something to someone: 她的英文老師也對她說.

text.traditional:
宜文：
昨天我去百貨公司買夏天的衣服。因為那裡的裙子都太貴了，所以我只買了一雙襪子。週末我們一起去書店看雜誌吧！
元真

宜文：
昨天我去百货公司买夏天的衣服。因为那里的裙子都太贵了，所以我只买了一双袜子。周末我们一起去书店看杂志吧！
元真

text.english: Yiwen: Yesterday I went to the department store to buy summer clothes. Because the skirts there were all too expensive, I only bought a pair of socks. Let's go to the bookstore together this weekend and look at magazines! Yuanzhen

prompt.traditional: 元真昨天在百貨公司買了什麼？

prompt.pinyin: Yuánzhēn zuótiān zài bǎihuò gōngsī mǎi le shénme?
prompt.english: What did Yuanzhen buy at the department store yesterday?

questions.why: 因為那裡的裙子都太貴了，所以我只買了一雙襪子: the skirts were too expensive, so she only bought socks. The magazines are for the weekend trip to the bookstore.

Straight on: on the phone map, the dotted route goes straight across the crossroads to the red pin
Turns right: on the phone map, the dotted route goes up to the crossroads and turns right to the red pin

Turns right: on the phone map, the dotted route goes up to the crossroads and turns right to the red pin

lines.speaker: F

choices.alt: Turns left: on the phone map, the dotted route goes up to the crossroads and turns left to the red pin

lines.english: I'd like to buy tickets: one each for me and my two children.

choices.alt: Two tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes two tickets out over the ticket counter
Three tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes three tickets out over the ticket counter
Four tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes four tickets out over the ticket counter

questions.why: One each (一個人一張) for her and her two children (我和兩個孩子): three tickets. Two would leave her out.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們要買幾張票？
lines.simplified: 你们要买几张票？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen yào mǎi jǐ zhāng piào?
lines.english: How many tickets would you like to buy?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們一共三個人，可是我已經有一張了。
lines.simplified: 我们一共三个人，可是我已经有一张了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yígòng sān ge rén, kěshì wǒ yǐjīng yǒu yì zhāng le.
lines.english: There are three of us, but I already have one.

choices.alt: Two tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes two tickets out over the ticket counter
Three tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes three tickets out over the ticket counter
Four tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes four tickets out over the ticket counter

questions.why: The seller asks how many tickets they will buy (買幾張票). There are three of them (一共三個人), but he already has one (已經有一張了), so he buys two, not three.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我跟爸爸、媽媽還有妹妹都要買票。
lines.simplified: 我跟爸爸、妈妈还有妹妹都要买票。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gēn bàba, māma hái yǒu mèimei dōu yào mǎi piào.
lines.english: Dad, Mom, my little sister and I all need to buy tickets.

choices.alt: Two tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes two tickets out over the ticket counter
Three tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes three tickets out over the ticket counter
Four tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes four tickets out over the ticket counter

questions.why: Count the people: 我, 爸爸, 媽媽 and 妹妹 are four, and 都要買票 means they all need tickets.

picture.alt: Daytime at the top of a museum's front steps. The big golden doors are open and a few other visitors are walking in. Outside on the steps stand three people who are already there: a curly-haired boy with glasses in an orange sweater, a boy in a green hoodie with an open navy jacket over it, and the teacher in a blue cardigan. On the right Zhongming, in a yellow jacket and with his backpack on, has just come up the steps and waves to them. None of the four has gone in.

questions.why: The four stand outside by the museum's open doors: 在博物館門口. Nobody has gone in yet, so 裡面 (inside) is wrong, and this is a museum, not a library (圖書館).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你這個週末有空嗎？
lines.simplified: 你这个周末有空吗？

questions.why: 下個星期一就要考試了: the exam is coming soon, next Monday. 這個週末 is only when she asks if he is free.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我二十分鐘以後到，電影開始了嗎？
lines.simplified: 我二十分钟以后到，电影开始了吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ èrshí fēnzhōng yǐhòu dào, diànyǐng kāishǐ le ma?
lines.english: I'll get there in twenty minutes. Has the movie started?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還沒，再十分鐘就要開始了。
lines.simplified: 还没，再十分钟就要开始了。
lines.pinyin: Hái méi, zài shí fēnzhōng jiù yào kāishǐ le.
lines.english: Not yet. It starts in ten more minutes.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Diànyǐng shénme shíhòu kāishǐ?
prompt.english: When does the movie start?

questions.why: 還沒 means it hasn't started yet, and 再十分鐘就要開始了 means it starts in ten more minutes. 二十分鐘以後 is when the man will get there.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你每天上網上幾個小時？
lines.simplified: 你每天上网上几个小时？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān shàngwǎng shàng jǐ ge xiǎoshí?
lines.english: How many hours a day do you spend online?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 平常一個小時，週末六個小時。
lines.simplified: 平常一个小时，周末六个小时。
lines.pinyin: Píngcháng yí ge xiǎoshí, zhōumò liù ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Usually one hour; on weekends, six.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的平常上網上幾個小時？
prompt.simplified: 男的平常上网上几个小时？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de píngcháng shàngwǎng shàng jǐ ge xiǎoshí?
prompt.english: How many hours does the man usually spend online?

questions.why: 平常一個小時: on a normal day he is online for one hour. 六個小時 is his weekend time (週末).

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳今天很累吧？
lines.simplified: 你今天很累吧？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān hěn lèi ba?
lines.english: You're tired today, aren't you?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對，我昨天晚上十一點睡覺，今天早上五點就起床了。
lines.simplified: 对，我昨天晚上十一点睡觉，今天早上五点就起床了。
lines.pinyin: Duì, wǒ zuótiān wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn shuìjiào, jīntiān zǎoshàng wǔ diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
lines.english: Yes. I went to bed at eleven last night and was already up at five this morning.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuì le jǐ ge xiǎoshí?
prompt.english: How many hours did the woman sleep?

questions.why: She went to bed at eleven last night (十一點睡覺) and got up at five this morning (五點起床): six hours of sleep. 十一 and 五 are clock times, not how long she slept.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你在家常常聽音樂嗎？
lines.simplified: 你在家常常听音乐吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zài jiā chángcháng tīng yīnyuè ma?
lines.english: Do you often listen to music at home?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 做飯的時候聽音樂，吃飯的時候看電視。
lines.simplified: 做饭的时候听音乐，吃饭的时候看电视。
lines.pinyin: Zuòfàn de shíhòu tīng yīnyuè, chī fàn de shíhòu kàn diànshì.
lines.english: I listen to music while I cook and watch TV while I eat.

lines.traditional: 妳在咖啡廳工作過嗎？
lines.simplified: 你在咖啡厅工作过吗？

lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu, kěshì wǒ zài miànbāo diàn shàng guo bān.
lines.english: No, but I've worked at a bakery.

prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zài nǎlǐ shàng guo bān?
prompt.english: Where has the woman worked?

questions.why: 沒有 answers the café question. She has worked (上過班) at a 麵包店, a bakery.

lines.english: I came last year; my younger sister came this year.

prompt.simplified: 女的是什么时候来台湾的？

prompt.english: When did the woman come to Taiwan?

lines.simplified: 你的功课都写了吗？

prompt.traditional: 三個人在排隊，第一個是女生，後面是兩個男生。
prompt.simplified: 三个人在排队，第一个是女生，后面是两个男生。
prompt.pinyin: Sān ge rén zài páiduì, dì yī ge shì nǚshēng, hòumiàn shì liǎng ge nánshēng.
prompt.english: Three people are standing in line. The first one is the girl, and behind her are two boys.

choices.alt: Girl first: at the bus stop the girl stands first in line, with two boys behind her
Girl second: one boy stands in front of the girl and one boy behind her
Girl last: both boys stand in front of the girl; she is at the end of the line

questions.why: 第一個是女生 means the first in line is the girl, and both boys are behind her (後面).

prompt.simplified: 三个人在排队，两个男生都在女生前面。
prompt.pinyin: Sān ge rén zài páiduì, liǎng ge nánshēng dōu zài nǚshēng qiánmiàn.
prompt.english: Three people are standing in line. Both boys are in front of the girl.

choices.alt: Girl first: at the bus stop the girl stands first in line, with two boys behind her
Girl second: one boy stands in front of the girl and one boy behind her
Girl last: both boys stand in front of the girl; she is at the end of the line

questions.why: Both boys (都) are in front of (前面) the girl, so she is last in line.

prompt.traditional: 三個人在排隊，第二個是女生，她前面和後面都有一個男生。
prompt.simplified: 三个人在排队，第二个是女生，她前面和后面都有一个男生。
prompt.pinyin: Sān ge rén zài páiduì, dì èr ge shì nǚshēng, tā qiánmiàn hé hòumiàn dōu yǒu yí ge nánshēng.
prompt.english: Three people are standing in line. The second one is the girl: there is one boy in front of her and one behind her.

choices.alt: Girl first: at the bus stop the girl stands first in line, with two boys behind her
Girl second: one boy stands in front of the girl and one boy behind her
Girl last: both boys stand in front of the girl; she is at the end of the line

questions.why: 第二個是女生 means the girl is second in line, with one boy in front of her (前面) and one behind her (後面).

prompt.traditional: 八點上課，可是他七點半就到教室了。
prompt.simplified: 八点上课，可是他七点半就到教室了。
prompt.pinyin: Bā diǎn shàngkè, kěshì tā qī diǎn bàn jiù dào jiàoshì le.
prompt.english: Class starts at eight, but he got to the classroom at seven thirty.

choices.alt: 7:30: the classroom clock shows half past seven as the boy walks in
8:00: the classroom clock shows eight o'clock as the boy walks in
8:30: the classroom clock shows half past eight as the boy walks in

questions.why: 七點半就到了: 就 shows he came early, at 7:30, before the 8:00 class.

prompt.traditional: 八點上課，他遲到了三十分鐘。
prompt.simplified: 八点上课，他迟到了三十分钟。
prompt.pinyin: Bā diǎn shàngkè, tā chídào le sānshí fēnzhōng.
prompt.english: Class starts at eight, and he was thirty minutes late.

choices.alt: 7:30: the classroom clock shows half past seven as the boy walks in
8:00: the classroom clock shows eight o'clock as the boy walks in
8:30: the classroom clock shows half past eight as the boy walks in

questions.why: 遲到了三十分鐘 means thirty minutes late: eight o'clock plus thirty minutes is 8:30.

prompt.traditional: 八點上課，他很準時，不早也不晚。
prompt.simplified: 八点上课，他很准时，不早也不晚。
prompt.pinyin: Bā diǎn shàngkè, tā hěn zhǔnshí, bù zǎo yě bù wǎn.
prompt.english: Class starts at eight; he's on time, not early and not late.

choices.alt: 7:30: the classroom clock shows half past seven as the boy walks in
8:00: the classroom clock shows eight o'clock as the boy walks in
8:30: the classroom clock shows half past eight as the boy walks in

questions.why: 準時 means on time, 不早也不晚 (not early, not late): he walks in at 8:00.

transcript.traditional: 歷史博物館　上午9:00—下午5:00　星期二不開門　票 一張150元　學生票 一張100元　介紹時間 上午10:00、下午2:00
transcript.simplified: 历史博物馆　上午9:00—下午5:00　星期二不开门　票 一张150元　学生票 一张100元　介绍时间 上午10:00、下午2:00
transcript.pinyin: Lìshǐ Bówùguǎn: shàngwǔ 9:00—xiàwǔ 5:00; xīngqí'èr bù kāimén; piào yì zhāng 150 yuán; xuéshēng piào yì zhāng 100 yuán; jièshào shíjiān shàngwǔ 10:00, xiàwǔ 2:00
transcript.english: History Museum: 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; closed on Tuesdays; tickets 150 each; student tickets 100 each; guided talks at 10:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m.

prompt.pinyin: Nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which one is true?

choices.traditional: 星期一上午十點可以來這裡參觀。
choices.simplified: 星期一上午十点可以来这里参观。
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíyī shàngwǔ shí diǎn kěyǐ lái zhèlǐ cānguān.
choices.english: You can visit here at 10 a.m. on Monday.

choices.traditional: 星期二下午三點可以來這裡參觀。
choices.simplified: 星期二下午三点可以来这里参观。
choices.pinyin: Xīngqí'èr xiàwǔ sān diǎn kěyǐ lái zhèlǐ cānguān.
choices.english: You can visit here at 3 p.m. on Tuesday.

choices.traditional: 星期六晚上七點可以來這裡參觀。
choices.simplified: 星期六晚上七点可以来这里参观。
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù wǎnshàng qī diǎn kěyǐ lái zhèlǐ cānguān.
choices.english: You can visit here at 7 p.m. on Saturday.

questions.why: The museum is open from 9:00 to 5:00 and closed only on Tuesdays (星期二不開門), so 10:00 on Monday is fine. On Tuesday it is closed, and at 7:00 in the evening it has been closed since 5:00.

prompt.traditional: 老師買一張票，三個學生買學生票，一共多少錢？
prompt.simplified: 老师买一张票，三个学生买学生票，一共多少钱？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎoshī mǎi yì zhāng piào, sān ge xuéshēng mǎi xuéshēng piào, yígòng duōshǎo qián?
prompt.english: The teacher buys one ticket, and three students buy student tickets. How much is that altogether?

questions.why: One ticket is 150元 and three student tickets are 3 × 100元: 150 + 300 = 450. 四百元 would be four student tickets, and 三百五十元 counts only two students.

prompt.traditional: 星期三上午，圖書館的網路有幾個小時不能用？
prompt.simplified: 星期三上午，图书馆的网路有几个小时不能用？
prompt.pinyin: Xīngqísān shàngwǔ, túshūguǎn de wǎnglù yǒu jǐ ge xiǎoshí bù néng yòng?
prompt.english: On Wednesday morning, for how many hours can't the library internet be used?

questions.why: From 8:00 to 11:00 is three hours (三個小時). 8 is the start time, not the length; 8, 9, 10 and 11 are four clock times but only three hours.

versions.alt: A museum exhibition room; the wall clock shows ten to five. On the left a woman guide points at a big picture of an old ship and talks to four students. On the right a boy talks loudly on his phone, and the two visitors next to him turn to look at him.

prompt.traditional: 那個男生在打電話，說話很＿＿，旁邊的人都在看他。
prompt.simplified: 那个男生在打电话，说话很＿＿，旁边的人都在看他。

answer.traditional: 那個男生在打電話，說話很大聲，旁邊的人都在看他。
answer.simplified: 那个男生在打电话，说话很大声，旁边的人都在看他。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng zài dǎ diànhuà, shuōhuà hěn dàshēng, pángbiān de rén dōu zài kàn tā.
answer.english: That boy is on the phone, talking very loudly, and the people next to him are looking at him.

questions.why: In the picture he talks loudly into his phone and the people next to him (旁邊的人) turn to look: 大聲 means loud. 安靜 is the opposite, and 準時 (on time) says nothing about talking.

prompt.traditional: 那位小姐在跟學生＿＿這張圖片。
prompt.simplified: 那位小姐在跟学生＿＿这张图片。

answer.traditional: 那位小姐在跟學生介紹這張圖片。
answer.simplified: 那位小姐在跟学生介绍这张图片。
answer.pinyin: Nà wèi xiǎojiě zài gēn xuéshēng jièshào zhè zhāng túpiàn.
answer.english: That woman is telling the students about this picture.

questions.why: 跟學生介紹 means to introduce something to the students: she explains the picture. You 參觀 a place, not a picture, and 排隊 (line up) takes no object.

prompt.traditional: 這張圖片很有趣，請你也看＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 这张图片很有趣，请你也看＿＿。

answer.traditional: 這張圖片很有趣，請你也看看。
answer.simplified: 这张图片很有趣，请你也看看。
answer.pinyin: Zhè zhāng túpiàn hěn yǒuqù, qǐng nǐ yě kànkan.
answer.english: This picture is interesting. Please have a look too.

questions.why: 看看 repeats the verb for a light “have a look” in a polite request with 請. 看到 and 看過 say what someone saw or has seen; they do not make a request.

versions.alt: A museum exhibition room; the wall clock shows ten to five. On the left a woman guide points at a big picture of an old ship and talks to four students. On the right a boy talks loudly on his phone, and the two visitors next to him turn to look at him.

prompt.traditional: 博物館五點關門，現在四點五十分，＿＿關門了。
prompt.simplified: 博物馆五点关门，现在四点五十分，＿＿关门了。

answer.traditional: 博物館五點關門，現在四點五十分，就要關門了。
answer.simplified: 博物馆五点关门，现在四点五十分，就要关门了。
answer.pinyin: Bówùguǎn wǔ diǎn guānmén, xiànzài sì diǎn wǔshí fēn, jiù yào guānmén le.
answer.english: The museum closes at five. It's ten to five now, so it will close soon.

questions.why: It closes at five (五點關門) and it is only 4:50, so it has not closed yet: 就要……了 means it will close soon. 已經 and 剛剛 would mean it has closed already.

prompt.traditional: 從四點半到現在，那個男生打電話打了二十＿＿了。
prompt.simplified: 从四点半到现在，那个男生打电话打了二十＿＿了。

answer.traditional: 從四點半到現在，那個男生打電話打了二十分鐘了。
answer.simplified: 从四点半到现在，那个男生打电话打了二十分钟了。
answer.pinyin: Cóng sì diǎn bàn dào xiànzài, nàge nánshēng dǎ diànhuà dǎ le èrshí fēnzhōng le.
answer.english: From half past four until now, that boy has been on the phone for twenty minutes.

questions.why: How long goes after the repeated verb: 打電話打了二十分鐘, from 4:30 to the 4:50 on the clock. 點 is a clock time and 號 a date, not a length of time.

prompt.traditional: 那位小姐在說這張圖片的故事，我們一起去聽＿＿，好嗎？
prompt.simplified: 那位小姐在说这张图片的故事，我们一起去听＿＿，好吗？

answer.traditional: 那位小姐在說這張圖片的故事，我們一起去聽聽，好嗎？
answer.simplified: 那位小姐在说这张图片的故事，我们一起去听听，好吗？
answer.pinyin: Nà wèi xiǎojiě zài shuō zhè zhāng túpiàn de gùshì, wǒmen yìqǐ qù tīngting, hǎo ma?
answer.english: That woman is telling the story of this picture. Shall we go and have a listen?

questions.why: 聽聽 repeats the verb for a light “have a listen” in a suggestion (……，好嗎？). 聽說 means to hear it said, and 聽過 is for past experience; neither makes a suggestion.

passage.traditional: 星期六我{1}妹妹去參觀博物館。我們從捷運站走十分鐘{2}到了。博物館九點開門，我們八點半到，在門口等了{3}。妹妹很喜歡那裡的畫，看了兩個小時還不想走。我們{4}捷運回家的時候，她說下個月還想再來。
passage.simplified: 星期六我{1}妹妹去参观博物馆。我们从捷运站走十分钟{2}到了。博物馆九点开门，我们八点半到，在门口等了{3}。妹妹很喜欢那里的画，看了两个小时还不想走。我们{4}捷运回家的时候，她说下个月还想再来。
passage.pinyin: Xīngqíliù wǒ dài mèimei qù cānguān bówùguǎn. Wǒmen cóng jiéyùn zhàn zǒu shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Bówùguǎn jiǔ diǎn kāimén, wǒmen bā diǎn bàn dào, zài ménkǒu děng le bàn ge xiǎoshí. Mèimei hěn xǐhuān nàlǐ de huà, kàn le liǎng ge xiǎoshí hái bù xiǎng zǒu. Wǒmen zuò jiéyùn huí jiā de shíhòu, tā shuō xià ge yuè hái xiǎng zài lái.
passage.english: On Saturday I took my little sister to visit a museum. From the MRT station we walked ten minutes, and we were there. The museum opens at nine; we got there at eight thirty and waited at the door for half an hour. My sister loved the paintings there; after two hours she still didn't want to leave. When we took the MRT home, she said she wanted to come again next month.

questions.why: 帶 + a person means to take someone along: 我帶妹妹去 means I take my sister there.
就 links an action to its easy result: walk ten minutes from the station, and then (就) you are there.
From 8:30 to 9:00 they waited: 等了半個小時, half an hour. The length of time goes after the verb.
坐捷運 means to take the MRT. 往 needs a direction after it, like 往右.

passage.traditional: {1}我的手機不能上網，我很擔心。同學說：「你先等十分鐘，{2}可以上網了。」十分鐘以後，我的手機真的能上網了。我馬上{3}了一{4}電子郵件給老師。
passage.simplified: {1}我的手机不能上网，我很担心。同学说：「你先等十分钟，{2}可以上网了。」十分钟以后，我的手机真的能上网了。我马上{3}了一{4}电子邮件给老师。
passage.pinyin: Gānggāng wǒ de shǒujī bù néng shàngwǎng, wǒ hěn dānxīn. Tóngxué shuō: “Nǐ xiān děng shí fēnzhōng, jiù kěyǐ shàngwǎng le.” Shí fēnzhōng yǐhòu, wǒ de shǒujī zhēnde néng shàngwǎng le. Wǒ mǎshàng jì le yì fēng diànzǐ yóujiàn gěi lǎoshī.
passage.english: A little while ago my phone couldn't go online, and I was worried. A classmate said, “Wait ten minutes first, and then you can go online.” Ten minutes later, my phone really could go online. Right away I sent an email to my teacher.

questions.why: 剛剛 means a little while ago: it opens the story and says when the phone could not go online.
就 gives the easy result: wait ten minutes first, and then (就) you can go online.
寄 means to send: 寄了一封電子郵件 means sent an email.
Emails and letters take 封: 一封電子郵件. 張 is for flat things like tickets and pictures.

我現在在宿舍寫作業，晚上七點要去圖書館。妳要不要跟我一起去？
友美

這個星期天，要是天氣不冷，我們就去騎腳踏車；要是很冷，我們就去咖啡廳喝下午茶。你覺得怎麼樣？

prompt.english: If it's very cold on Sunday, what will they do?

questions.why: 要是很冷，我們就去咖啡廳喝下午茶: if it is cold, then afternoon tea. The bike ride is for a day that isn't cold.

lines.english: The building on the left is a little taller than the one on the right.

choices.alt: Left a little taller: two office buildings side by side; the left one is only a little taller than the right one (about one fifth taller)
Left much taller: the same two buildings; the left one is about twice as tall as the right one
Right taller: the same two buildings; the right one is clearly taller than the left one (about one and a half times as tall)

questions.why: 比右邊那棟高一點: the left building is only a little taller. 高多了 would mean much taller.

prompt.traditional: 公園裡有三＿＿大樹，環境很好。
prompt.simplified: 公园里有三＿＿大树，环境很好。

answer.traditional: 公園裡有三棵大樹，環境很好。
answer.simplified: 公园里有三棵大树，环境很好。

answer.english: There are three big trees in the park; it's a lovely place.

questions.why: Trees take the measure word 棵: 三棵大樹. 條 is for roads and 張 for tables.

prompt.traditional: 那位老先生坐在椅子上看書，已經看了一個小時＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 那位老先生坐在椅子上看书，已经看了一个小时＿＿。

answer.traditional: 那位老先生坐在椅子上看書，已經看了一個小時了。
answer.simplified: 那位老先生坐在椅子上看书，已经看了一个小时了。
answer.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng zuò zài yǐzi shàng kàn shū, yǐjīng kàn le yí ge xiǎoshí le.
answer.english: The old man is reading on the bench; he has been reading for an hour now.

questions.why: 已經……看了一個小時了: the second 了 says he is still reading now. 過 and 的 can't end this sentence.

prompt.traditional: 今天是新年，＿＿公園裡的人比平常多。
prompt.simplified: 今天是新年，＿＿公园里的人比平常多。

answer.traditional: 今天是新年，所以公園裡的人比平常多。
answer.simplified: 今天是新年，所以公园里的人比平常多。
answer.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīnnián, suǒyǐ gōngyuán lǐ de rén bǐ píngcháng duō.
answer.english: Today is New Year's Day, so there are more people in the park than usual.

questions.why: 所以 brings in the result: it is New Year's Day, so the park is busier. 因為 would have to come before the reason, and 如果 (if) would leave the sentence unfinished.

prompt.traditional: 那個孩子站在樹下面，他媽媽＿＿在椅子上休息。
prompt.simplified: 那个孩子站在树下面，他妈妈＿＿在椅子上休息。

prompt.traditional: 你們在公園裡玩了＿＿了？——一個多小時了，孩子還不想回家。
prompt.simplified: 你们在公园里玩了＿＿了？——一个多小时了，孩子还不想回家。

questions.why: The reply gives a length of time (一個多小時了), so the question is 多久, how long. 多少 asks how many or how much, and 什麼 asks what.

answer.english: This park is big and pretty, and it has lots of flowers too.
