passage.traditional: 我在台北學中文學了半年{1}。十二月三十一號晚上，我跟同學去看跨年演唱會。那裡的人{2}我想的多，真熱鬧！因為人太多了，我們沒有地方坐，在那裡{3}了四個小時。我們回到家的時候，{4}兩點了。
passage.simplified: 我在台北学中文学了半年{1}。十二月三十一号晚上，我跟同学去看跨年演唱会。那里的人{2}我想的多，真热闹！因为人太多了，我们没有地方坐，在那里{3}了四个小时。我们回到家的时候，{4}两点了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiběi xué Zhōngwén xué le bàn nián le. Shí'èr yuè sānshíyī hào wǎnshàng, wǒ gēn tóngxué qù kàn kuànián yǎnchànghuì. Nàlǐ de rén bǐ wǒ xiǎng de duō, zhēn rènao! Yīnwèi rén tài duō le, wǒmen méiyǒu dìfāng zuò, zài nàlǐ zhàn le sì ge xiǎoshí. Wǒmen huí dào jiā de shíhòu, yǐjīng liǎng diǎn le.
passage.english: I've been studying Chinese in Taipei for half a year. On the night of December 31, my classmates and I went to a New Year's Eve concert. There were more people than I expected; it was so lively! It was too crowded to find a seat, so we stood there for four hours. When we got home, it was already two o'clock.

questions.why: 學了半年了: the second 了 says it has been half a year up to now, and the studying goes on.
比 compares the two: 那裡的人比我想的多, more people than I expected.
沒有地方坐 means there were no seats, so they 站了四個小時, stood for four hours. 坐 would contradict it.
回到家的時候，已經兩點了: it was already two o'clock when they got home.

passage.traditional: 上個月我去美國找姐姐，在她家住{1}兩個星期。她住的城市不大，可是{2}很好，她家前面有一個公園。我在那裡{3}，每天早上都跟姐姐去公園跑步。那裡的人走路走得比台北人{4}，大家都不太忙。
passage.simplified: 上个月我去美国找姐姐，在她家住{1}两个星期。她住的城市不大，可是{2}很好，她家前面有一个公园。我在那里{3}，每天早上都跟姐姐去公园跑步。那里的人走路走得比台北人{4}，大家都不太忙。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè wǒ qù Měiguó zhǎo jiějie, zài tā jiā zhù le liǎng ge xīngqí. Tā zhù de chéngshì bú dà, kěshì huánjìng hěn hǎo, tā jiā qiánmiàn yǒu yí ge gōngyuán. Wǒ zài nàlǐ de shíhòu, měi tiān zǎoshàng dōu gēn jiějie qù gōngyuán pǎobù. Nàlǐ de rén zǒulù zǒu de bǐ Táiběi rén màn, dàjiā dōu bú tài máng.
passage.english: Last month I went to the US to visit my older sister and stayed at her place for two weeks. The city she lives in isn't big, but it's a lovely place, and there is a park in front of her home. While I was there, I went running in the park with her every morning. People there walk more slowly than people in Taipei, and nobody is very busy.

questions.why: 住了兩個星期: a stay of two weeks that is now over (the writer is back).
環境很好: the surroundings are nice, with a park in front of the home.
我在那裡的時候 means while I was there; it sets the time for 每天早上.
比台北人慢: they walk more slowly than people in Taipei, and 大家都不太忙 backs it up.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不一樣，我屬蛇，她屬龍。
lines.simplified: 不一样，我属蛇，她属龙。
lines.pinyin: Bù yíyàng, wǒ shǔ shé, tā shǔ lóng.
lines.english: No, they're different. I'm a Snake and she's a Dragon.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Nǚshēng shǔ shénme?
prompt.english: What is the woman's zodiac sign?

questions.why: She says 不一樣: she is a Snake (我屬蛇); the Dragon is her sister.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳屬雞嗎？
lines.simplified: 你属鸡吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shǔ jī ma?
lines.english: Are you a Rooster?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不是，我屬豬，我哥哥屬雞。
lines.simplified: 不是，我属猪，我哥哥属鸡。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì, wǒ shǔ zhū, wǒ gēge shǔ jī.
lines.english: No, I'm a Pig. My older brother is a Rooster.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Nǚshēng de gēge shǔ shénme?
prompt.english: What is the woman's older brother's zodiac sign?

questions.why: She says 我哥哥屬雞: her brother is a Rooster. The Pig (屬豬) is her own sign.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你剛才在睡覺嗎？
lines.simplified: 你刚才在睡觉吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ gāngcái zài shuìjiào ma?
lines.english: Were you sleeping just now?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒有，我剛才在打電話，現在要去看電視。
lines.simplified: 没有，我刚才在打电话，现在要去看电视。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu, wǒ gāngcái zài dǎ diànhuà, xiànzài yào qù kàn diànshì.
lines.english: No, I was on the phone just now. Now I'm going to watch TV.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Nánshēng gāngcái zài zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What was the man doing just now?

questions.why: He says 沒有 to sleeping: 我剛才在打電話, he was on the phone just now. Watching TV (看電視) is what he will do now (現在), not what he did.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 剛才跟妳講話的人是妳同學嗎？
lines.simplified: 刚才跟你讲话的人是你同学吗？
lines.pinyin: Gāngcái gēn nǐ jiǎnghuà de rén shì nǐ tóngxué ma?
lines.english: Was the person talking to you just now your classmate?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不是，是我同事，我們一起在銀行上班。
lines.simplified: 不是，是我同事，我们一起在银行上班。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì, shì wǒ tóngshì, wǒmen yìqǐ zài yínháng shàngbān.
lines.english: No, it was my colleague. We work at the bank together.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 剛才跟女生講話的是誰？
prompt.simplified: 刚才跟女生讲话的是谁？
prompt.pinyin: Gāngcái gēn nǚshēng jiǎnghuà de shì shéi?
prompt.english: Who was talking to the woman just now?

questions.why: She says 不是 to 同學: it was 我同事, a colleague she works with at the bank.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 剛才那個人是越南人嗎？
lines.simplified: 刚才那个人是越南人吗？
lines.pinyin: Gāngcái nàge rén shì Yuènán rén ma?
lines.english: Was that person just now Vietnamese?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不是，我剛才問了他，原來他是日本人。
lines.simplified: 不是，我刚才问了他，原来他是日本人。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì, wǒ gāngcái wèn le tā, yuánlái tā shì Rìběn rén.
lines.english: No. I asked him just now; it turns out he's Japanese.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Nàge rén shì nǎ guó rén?
prompt.english: Which country is that person from?

questions.why: She says 不是 to Vietnamese. She asked him (我剛才問了他), and 原來他是日本人: it turns out he is Japanese.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你跟妹妹在台北住了多久了？
lines.simplified: 你跟妹妹在台北住了多久了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ gēn mèimei zài Táiběi zhù le duōjiǔ le?
lines.english: How long have you and your younger sister lived in Taipei?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我住了兩年了，妹妹住了半年了。
lines.simplified: 我住了两年了，妹妹住了半年了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhù le liǎng nián le, mèimei zhù le bàn nián le.
lines.english: I've lived here two years, and my sister half a year.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男生在台北住了多久了？
prompt.simplified: 男生在台北住了多久了？
prompt.pinyin: Nánshēng zài Táiběi zhù le duōjiǔ le?
prompt.english: How long has the man lived in Taipei?

questions.why: He says 我住了兩年了: two years so far. Half a year (半年) is his sister.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 請問，博物館怎麼走？
lines.simplified: 请问，博物馆怎么走？
lines.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, bówùguǎn zěnme zǒu?
lines.english: Excuse me, how do I get to the museum?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 第一個路口不要轉，到第二個路口再往左轉。
lines.simplified: 第一个路口不要转，到第二个路口再往左转。
lines.pinyin: Dì yī ge lùkǒu bú yào zhuǎn, dào dì èr ge lùkǒu zài wǎng zuǒ zhuǎn.
lines.english: Don't turn at the first intersection. Go on to the second intersection, and then turn left.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Yào zài nǎlǐ wǎng zuǒ zhuǎn?
prompt.english: Where do you turn left?

questions.why: 第一個路口不要轉: don't turn at the first intersection. 到第二個路口再往左轉: go on to the second one, then turn left.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這盤菜是妳做的嗎？很好吃！
lines.simplified: 这盘菜是你做的吗？很好吃！
lines.pinyin: Zhè pán cài shì nǐ zuò de ma? Hěn hǎochī!
lines.english: Did you make this dish? It's delicious!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不是我做的，是我爸爸做的。
lines.simplified: 不是我做的，是我爸爸做的。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì wǒ zuò de, shì wǒ bàba zuò de.
lines.english: I didn't make it. My dad did.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Zhè pán cài shì shéi zuò de?
prompt.english: Who made this dish?

questions.why: 不是我做的，是我爸爸做的: 是…的 points to who made it, her dad.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你畢業以後想當記者嗎？
lines.simplified: 你毕业以后想当记者吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bìyè yǐhòu xiǎng dāng jìzhě ma?
lines.english: Do you want to be a reporter after you graduate?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 以前想，現在我想當老師。
lines.simplified: 以前想，现在我想当老师。
lines.pinyin: Yǐqián xiǎng, xiànzài wǒ xiǎng dāng lǎoshī.
lines.english: I used to. Now I want to be a teacher.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Nánshēng xiànzài xiǎng dāng shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man want to be now?

questions.why: 以前 (before) he wanted to be a reporter; 現在 (now) he wants to be a teacher.

prompt.pinyin: Dìdi gēn mèimei yíyàng gāo.
prompt.english: My younger brother is as tall as my younger sister.

choices.alt: Same height: the boy and the girl stand side by side, exactly as tall as each other
Girl taller: the girl is clearly taller than the boy, by about a head
Boy taller: the boy is clearly taller than the girl, by about a head

questions.why: 跟…一樣高 means as tall as: the boy and the girl are the same height.

prompt.traditional: 妹妹跟弟弟不一樣高，妹妹比較高。
prompt.simplified: 妹妹跟弟弟不一样高，妹妹比较高。
prompt.pinyin: Mèimei gēn dìdi bù yíyàng gāo, mèimei bǐjiào gāo.
prompt.english: My younger sister and brother aren't the same height; my sister is taller.

choices.alt: Same height: the boy and the girl stand side by side, exactly as tall as each other
Girl taller: the girl is clearly taller than the boy, by about a head
Boy taller: the boy is clearly taller than the girl, by about a head

questions.why: 不一樣高 means they are not the same height, and 妹妹比較高 means the girl is the taller one.

prompt.traditional: 弟弟跟妹妹不一樣高，妹妹比較矮。
prompt.simplified: 弟弟跟妹妹不一样高，妹妹比较矮。
prompt.pinyin: Dìdi gēn mèimei bù yíyàng gāo, mèimei bǐjiào ǎi.
prompt.english: My younger brother and sister aren't the same height; my sister is shorter.

choices.alt: Same height: the boy and the girl stand side by side, exactly as tall as each other
Girl taller: the girl is clearly taller than the boy, by about a head
Boy taller: the boy is clearly taller than the girl, by about a head

questions.why: 不一樣高 rules out the first picture, and 妹妹比較矮 means the girl is the shorter one, so the boy is taller.

prompt.traditional: 圖書館的門開著，窗戶關著。
prompt.simplified: 图书馆的门开着，窗户关着。
prompt.pinyin: Túshūguǎn de mén kāizhe, chuānghù guānzhe.
prompt.english: The library door is open and the window is shut.

choices.alt: Door open, window closed: in the library room the door stands open and the window is shut
Door closed, window open: in the library room the door is shut and the window stands open
Both open: in the library room the door and the window both stand open

questions.why: 開著 means it stays open and 關著 means it stays shut: the door is open, the window is shut.

prompt.traditional: 圖書館的窗戶開著，門關著。
prompt.simplified: 图书馆的窗户开着，门关着。
prompt.pinyin: Túshūguǎn de chuānghù kāizhe, mén guānzhe.
prompt.english: The library window is open and the door is shut.

choices.alt: Door open, window closed: in the library room the door stands open and the window is shut
Door closed, window open: in the library room the door is shut and the window stands open
Both open: in the library room the door and the window both stand open

questions.why: The window (窗戶) is 開著, open, and the door (門) is 關著, shut.

prompt.traditional: 圖書館的門跟窗戶都開著。
prompt.simplified: 图书馆的门跟窗户都开着。
prompt.pinyin: Túshūguǎn de mén gēn chuānghù dōu kāizhe.
prompt.english: The library door and window are both open.

choices.alt: Door open, window closed: in the library room the door stands open and the window is shut
Door closed, window open: in the library room the door is shut and the window stands open
Both open: in the library room the door and the window both stand open

questions.why: 門跟窗戶都開著: both the door and the window are open (都).

versions.alt: A poster for a paper-craft class: making the twelve zodiac animals out of paper, with the day, the time and the prices for adults and children

transcript.traditional: 用紙做十二生肖動物　星期六　下午2:00－4:00　大人 200元　小孩 100元　小孩要跟大人一起來
transcript.simplified: 用纸做十二生肖动物　星期六　下午2:00－4:00　大人 200元　小孩 100元　小孩要跟大人一起来
transcript.pinyin: Yòng zhǐ zuò shí'èr shēngxiào dòngwù: xīngqíliù, xiàwǔ 2:00–4:00; dàrén 200 yuán, xiǎohái 100 yuán; xiǎohái yào gēn dàrén yìqǐ lái
transcript.english: Make the twelve zodiac animals out of paper: Saturday, 2:00–4:00 p.m.; adults 200, children 100; children must come with an adult

prompt.pinyin: Nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which one is true?

choices.traditional: 一個大人跟一個小孩一共三百元。
choices.simplified: 一个大人跟一个小孩一共三百元。
choices.pinyin: Yí ge dàrén gēn yí ge xiǎohái yígòng sān bǎi yuán.
choices.english: One adult and one child cost 300 altogether.

choices.traditional: 這個活動是在星期六的上午。
choices.simplified: 这个活动是在星期六的上午。
choices.pinyin: Zhège huódòng shì zài xīngqíliù de shàngwǔ.
choices.english: This activity is on Saturday morning.

choices.traditional: 小孩不跟大人一起來，也可以參加。
choices.simplified: 小孩不跟大人一起来，也可以参加。
choices.pinyin: Xiǎohái bù gēn dàrén yìqǐ lái, yě kěyǐ cānjiā.
choices.english: Children can join without coming with an adult.

questions.why: 200元 + 100元 = 300元 altogether (一共). The class is in the afternoon (下午), not the morning, and children must come with an adult (要跟大人一起來).

versions.alt: A sunny animal farm by a small river: a father has brought his son, a boy of about nine, and his younger daughter, a little girl of about five. By the river a tall brown horse stands next to two white sheep. The boy holds out a red apple to the horse; the girl holds a red apple of the same size and laughs at exactly three chickens, each one fully visible. Under a tree, exactly two pigs of the same size are asleep. There are no other chickens or pigs.

prompt.traditional: 哥哥手裡拿著一個＿＿，他想給馬吃。
prompt.simplified: 哥哥手里拿着一个＿＿，他想给马吃。

answer.traditional: 哥哥手裡拿著一個蘋果，他想給馬吃。
answer.simplified: 哥哥手里拿着一个苹果，他想给马吃。
answer.pinyin: Gēge shǒu lǐ názhe yí ge píngguǒ, tā xiǎng gěi mǎ chī.
answer.english: The older brother is holding an apple; he wants to give it to the horse.

questions.why: In the picture the boy holds out a red apple (蘋果) to the horse. There is no banana (香蕉) or bread (麵包) in the picture.

answer.traditional: 這裡的雞比豬多。
answer.simplified: 这里的鸡比猪多。
answer.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jī bǐ zhū duō.
answer.english: There are more chickens than pigs here.

questions.why: Count them: three chickens (雞) and two pigs (豬), so 雞比豬多. 比豬少 says the opposite, and 跟豬一樣多 would need the same number.

answer.traditional: 妹妹一看到雞，就很高興。
answer.simplified: 妹妹一看到鸡，就很高兴。
answer.pinyin: Mèimei yí kàndào jī, jiù hěn gāoxìng.
answer.english: As soon as the little sister sees the chickens, she is happy.

questions.why: 一……就…… means the second thing comes right after the first: as soon as she sees the chickens, she is happy. 再 (next; again) and 太 (too) do not pair with 一 like this.

versions.alt: A sunny animal farm by a small river: a father has brought his son, a boy of about nine, and his younger daughter, a little girl of about five. By the river a tall brown horse stands next to two white sheep. The boy holds out a red apple to the horse; the girl holds a red apple of the same size and laughs at exactly three chickens, each one fully visible. Under a tree, exactly two pigs of the same size are asleep. There are no other chickens or pigs.

answer.traditional: 河旁邊有兩隻羊。
answer.simplified: 河旁边有两只羊。
answer.pinyin: Hé pángbiān yǒu liǎng zhī yáng.
answer.english: There are two sheep by the river.

questions.why: Animals like sheep take 隻: 兩隻羊. 條 is for snakes and rivers, and 張 is for paper and tables.

prompt.traditional: 爸爸＿＿著哥哥跟妹妹來看動物。
prompt.simplified: 爸爸＿＿着哥哥跟妹妹来看动物。

answer.traditional: 爸爸帶著哥哥跟妹妹來看動物。
answer.simplified: 爸爸带着哥哥跟妹妹来看动物。
answer.pinyin: Bàba dàizhe gēge gēn mèimei lái kàn dòngwù.
answer.english: Dad has brought the brother and sister to see the animals.

questions.why: You 帶 (take along) people: 帶著哥哥跟妹妹. 拿 is for things in your hand, and 穿 is for clothes.

prompt.traditional: 樹下的這隻豬跟那隻豬＿＿大。
prompt.simplified: 树下的这只猪跟那只猪＿＿大。

answer.traditional: 樹下的這隻豬跟那隻豬一樣大。
answer.simplified: 树下的这只猪跟那只猪一样大。
answer.pinyin: Shù xià de zhè zhī zhū gēn nà zhī zhū yíyàng dà.
answer.english: This pig under the tree is as big as that one.

questions.why: 跟…一樣大 means as big as: the two pigs under the tree are the same size, so not 不一樣. 一起 (together) cannot stand before 大 like this.

passage.traditional: 今天是我的生日。我是兔年{1}的，所以媽媽送我一個兔子蛋糕，我一看{2}很喜歡。我在台灣住{3}三年了，這是我在台灣過的第三個生日。朋友說兔子很可愛，在十二生肖裡很{4}。
passage.simplified: 今天是我的生日。我是兔年{1}的，所以妈妈送我一个兔子蛋糕，我一看{2}很喜欢。我在台湾住{3}三年了，这是我在台湾过的第三个生日。朋友说兔子很可爱，在十二生肖里很{4}。
passage.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì. Wǒ shì tù nián chūshēng de, suǒyǐ māma sòng wǒ yí ge tùzi dàngāo, wǒ yí kàn jiù hěn xǐhuān. Wǒ zài Táiwān zhù le sān nián le, zhè shì wǒ zài Táiwān guò de dì sān ge shēngrì. Péngyǒu shuō tùzi hěn kě'ài, zài shí'èr shēngxiào lǐ hěn shòu huānyíng.
passage.english: Today is my birthday. I was born in the Year of the Rabbit, so Mom gave me a rabbit cake, and I loved it the moment I saw it. I have lived in Taiwan for three years now; this is my third birthday in Taiwan. My friends say rabbits are cute and very popular among the twelve zodiac animals.

questions.why: 兔年出生的 means born in the Year of the Rabbit.
一看就很喜歡: 一 … 就 … means the writer loved it the moment they saw it.
住了三年了: the second 了 shows the writer still lives here, three years so far.
很受歡迎 means very popular. 一樣 would need 跟 and a second thing to compare.

passage.traditional: 我以前不知道自己屬什麼，所以{1}去問了媽媽。{2}我屬羊！我哥哥屬蛇，他的生肖{3}我的不一樣。十二生肖裡，每一種動物都{4}一年，真有意思。
passage.simplified: 我以前不知道自己属什么，所以{1}去问了妈妈。{2}我属羊！我哥哥属蛇，他的生肖{3}我的不一样。十二生肖里，每一种动物都{4}一年，真有意思。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián bù zhīdào zìjǐ shǔ shénme, suǒyǐ gāngcái qù wèn le māma. Yuánlái wǒ shǔ yáng! Wǒ gēge shǔ shé, tā de shēngxiào gēn wǒ de bù yíyàng. Shí'èr shēngxiào lǐ, měi yì zhǒng dòngwù dōu dàibiǎo yì nián, zhēn yǒu yìsi.
passage.english: I didn't know my zodiac sign before, so just now I went and asked Mom. It turns out I'm a Goat! My older brother is a Snake; his sign is different from mine. In the zodiac, each animal stands for one year. How interesting.

questions.why: 剛才 means just now: the writer went and asked Mom a moment ago.
原來 introduces what the writer found out from Mom: it turns out they are a Goat (屬羊).
A 跟 B 不一樣 means A is different from B. 一樣 is already in the sentence after 不.
每一種動物都代表一年: each animal stands for (代表) one year.

text.traditional:
元真：
這個星期天我想去參觀科學展，妳要不要一起去？從捷運站走路五分鐘就到了。聽說去看的人很多，買票要排隊排很久，所以我們早一點去吧。九點在捷運站門口見，好嗎？
宜文
text.simplified:
元真：
这个星期天我想去参观科学展，你要不要一起去？从捷运站走路五分钟就到了。听说去看的人很多，买票要排队排很久，所以我们早一点去吧。九点在捷运站门口见，好吗？
宜文
text.pinyin: Yuánzhēn: Zhège xīngqítiān wǒ xiǎng qù cānguān kēxué zhǎn, nǐ yào bu yào yìqǐ qù? Cóng jiéyùn zhàn zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Tīngshuō qù kàn de rén hěn duō, mǎi piào yào páiduì pái hěn jiǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen zǎo yìdiǎn qù ba. Jiǔ diǎn zài jiéyùn zhàn ménkǒu jiàn, hǎo ma? Yíwén
text.english: Yuanzhen: This Sunday I'd like to visit the science exhibition. Do you want to come? It's a five-minute walk from the MRT station. I hear lots of people go, and the ticket line is long, so let's go early. Shall we meet at nine at the MRT station entrance? Yiwen

prompt.pinyin: Nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which one is true?

choices.pinyin: páiduì mǎi piào yào děng hěn jiǔ
jiǔ diǎn zài kēxué zhǎn ménkǒu jiàn
choices.english: they meet at nine at the exhibition entrance

choices.pinyin: qù kàn de rén bù duō

questions.why: Yiwen writes 買票要排隊排很久: the ticket line is long. They meet at the MRT station entrance (捷運站門口), not at the exhibition, and many people go (去看的人很多).

text.traditional:
中明：
我今天問了老闆，他說我們麵包店週末還需要一個人，一天只工作兩個小時。如果你想來，明天下課以後跟我一起去見老闆吧。
國安
text.simplified:
中明：
我今天问了老板，他说我们面包店周末还需要一个人，一天只工作两个小时。如果你想来，明天下课以后跟我一起去见老板吧。
国安
text.pinyin: Zhōngmíng: Wǒ jīntiān wèn le lǎobǎn, tā shuō wǒmen miànbāo diàn zhōumò hái xūyào yí ge rén, yì tiān zhǐ gōngzuò liǎng ge xiǎoshí. Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng lái, míngtiān xiàkè yǐhòu gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù jiàn lǎobǎn ba. Guó'ān
text.english: Zhongming: I asked my boss today. He says our bakery still needs one more person on weekends, and it's only two hours a day. If you'd like to come, go with me to meet the boss tomorrow after class. Guo'an

prompt.traditional: 中明什麼時候可以去見老闆？
prompt.simplified: 中明什么时候可以去见老板？
prompt.pinyin: Zhōngmíng shénme shíhòu kěyǐ qù jiàn lǎobǎn?
prompt.english: When can Zhongming go to meet the boss?

questions.why: Guo'an writes 明天下課以後跟我一起去見老闆: tomorrow after class (下課以後), not before class (上課以前). 今天 is when Guo'an asked the boss.

lines.english: It's snowing on the mountain, but the wind isn't strong.

choices.alt: Snow: snowflakes fall straight down on the mountain path; snow covers the trees and the bench, and the trees stand still
Rain: heavy rain falls on the mountain path; puddles on the ground, no snow, the trees stand still
Wind: a strong wind bends the trees and blows leaves across the dry mountain path; no rain, no snow

questions.why: 下雪了 means it is snowing. 風不大 says the wind is not strong, so it is not the windy picture.

lines.pinyin: Wán le sìshí fēnzhōng le, běnlái zhǐ xiǎng wán shí fēnzhōng.
lines.english: Forty minutes now. At first I only wanted to play for ten.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.pinyin: Tā wán yóuxì wán le duōjiǔ le?
prompt.english: How long has he been playing the game?

questions.why: 玩了四十分鐘了: he has been playing for forty minutes so far. 十分鐘 was only his first plan (本來).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 演唱會就要開始了，你在哪裡？
lines.simplified: 演唱会就要开始了，你在哪里？
lines.pinyin: Yǎnchànghuì jiù yào kāishǐ le, nǐ zài nǎlǐ?
lines.english: The concert is about to start. Where are you?

lines.traditional: 我剛剛下捷運，走路五分鐘就到。

lines.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng xià jiéyùn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào.

questions.why: 我剛剛下捷運: he just got off the MRT. The concert 就要開始了 (is about to start), so he has not watched it yet, and he came by MRT, not by bus.

prompt.english: What language do they chat in?

questions.why: 不是，我們都用中文聊天: they chat in Chinese, not in English. The classmate is Japanese, but they do not use 日文.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們兩個人在哪裡認識的？

prompt.speaker: N

versions.alt: A small mountain inn lobby on a snowy evening. Left: behind a wooden front desk the inn owner, a middle-aged man, holds an open paper map in his hand and talks with a young woman traveler; she stands at the desk with a backpack on, laughing with a big happy smile, and a few banknotes lie on the desk in front of her. Right: a young man traveler stands by a big window looking out; outside, heavy snow is falling and the mountains are all white

prompt.traditional: 旅館老闆手裡拿＿＿一張地圖，在跟一個女生說話。
prompt.simplified: 旅馆老板手里拿＿＿一张地图，在跟一个女生说话。

answer.traditional: 旅館老闆手裡拿著一張地圖，在跟一個女生說話。
answer.simplified: 旅馆老板手里拿着一张地图，在跟一个女生说话。
answer.pinyin: Lǚguǎn lǎobǎn shǒu lǐ názhe yì zhāng dìtú, zài gēn yí ge nǚshēng shuōhuà.
answer.english: The inn owner is holding a map in his hand and talking with a girl.

questions.why: 拿著 shows he is holding the map right now while he talks (在說話). 得 needs a description after it, and 拿過 (has held before) does not fit something happening now.

prompt.traditional: 那個女生下了公車，＿＿到旅館來了。
prompt.simplified: 那个女生下了公车，＿＿到旅馆来了。

answer.traditional: 那個女生下了公車，就到旅館來了。
answer.simplified: 那个女生下了公车，就到旅馆来了。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng xià le gōngchē, jiù dào lǚguǎn lái le.
answer.english: The girl got off the bus and came straight to the inn.

questions.why: 下了公車 is a finished action with 了, and 就 brings the next one right after it. 再 is for a next step that hasn't happened yet, so it can't go with the 了 at the end; 在 (in the middle of) can't come before 到…來了 like this.

prompt.traditional: 那個女生跟老闆聊天，笑得很＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 那个女生跟老板聊天，笑得很＿＿。

answer.traditional: 那個女生跟老闆聊天，笑得很開心。
answer.simplified: 那个女生跟老板聊天，笑得很开心。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng gēn lǎobǎn liáotiān, xiào de hěn kāixīn.
answer.english: The girl is chatting with the owner, laughing happily.

questions.why: She is laughing with a big happy smile in the picture: 笑得很開心. She does not look nervous (緊張) or strange (奇怪).

versions.alt: A small mountain inn lobby on a snowy evening. Left: behind a wooden front desk the inn owner, a middle-aged man, holds an open paper map in his hand and talks with a young woman traveler; she stands at the desk with a backpack on, laughing with a big happy smile, and a few banknotes lie on the desk in front of her. Right: a young man traveler stands by a big window looking out; outside, heavy snow is falling and the mountains are all white

prompt.traditional: 那個男生＿＿窗戶外面看，外面的山都白了。
prompt.simplified: 那个男生＿＿窗户外面看，外面的山都白了。

answer.traditional: 那個男生往窗戶外面看，外面的山都白了。
answer.simplified: 那个男生往窗户外面看，外面的山都白了。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng wǎng chuānghù wàimiàn kàn, wàimiàn de shān dōu bái le.
answer.english: The boy looks out of the window; the mountains outside have all turned white.

questions.why: 往 + place + 看 means looking toward it: he looks out of the window. 跟 and 給 need a person after them.

prompt.traditional: 那個女生付＿＿錢，就開始跟老闆聊天。
prompt.simplified: 那个女生付＿＿钱，就开始跟老板聊天。

answer.traditional: 那個女生付了錢，就開始跟老闆聊天。
answer.simplified: 那个女生付了钱，就开始跟老板聊天。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng fù le qián, jiù kāishǐ gēn lǎobǎn liáotiān.
answer.english: After the girl paid, she started chatting with the owner.

questions.why: V了O，就…: 了 after 付 makes paying a finished first step, and 就 brings the next one. 付著 (still paying) can't lead to a next step with 就, and 付的錢 is only a noun with no action.

prompt.traditional: 外面的雪下＿＿很大，他們都不想出去了。
prompt.simplified: 外面的雪下＿＿很大，他们都不想出去了。

answer.traditional: 外面的雪下得很大，他們都不想出去了。
answer.simplified: 外面的雪下得很大，他们都不想出去了。
answer.pinyin: Wàimiàn de xuě xià de hěn dà, tāmen dōu bù xiǎng chūqù le.
answer.english: It is snowing hard outside, so they don't want to go out anymore.

questions.why: 得 comes after the verb and before how it is going: 雪下得很大, the snow is falling hard. 了 and 著 cannot come before 很大 like this.

passage.traditional: 上個週末，我跟家人去花蓮玩。花蓮在台灣的{1}部，我們是坐火車去的。到了花蓮，我們先去旅館，再{2}公車去海邊。那裡的風很大，可是我們玩得很{3}。晚上，我們在旅館附近吃了很多花蓮有名的{4}。
passage.simplified: 上个周末，我跟家人去花莲玩。花莲在台湾的{1}部，我们是坐火车去的。到了花莲，我们先去旅馆，再{2}公车去海边。那里的风很大，可是我们玩得很{3}。晚上，我们在旅馆附近吃了很多花莲有名的{4}。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒ gēn jiārén qù Huālián wán. Huālián zài Táiwān de dōngbù, wǒmen shì zuò huǒchē qù de. Dào le Huālián, wǒmen xiān qù lǚguǎn, zài dā gōngchē qù hǎibiān. Nàlǐ de fēng hěn dà, kěshì wǒmen wán de hěn gāoxìng. Wǎnshàng, wǒmen zài lǚguǎn fùjìn chī le hěn duō Huālián yǒumíng de shíwù.
passage.english: Last weekend I went to Hualien with my family. Hualien is in eastern Taiwan, and we went there by train. In Hualien we went to our hotel first, and then we took a bus to the beach. It was very windy there, but we had a great time. In the evening we ate lots of Hualien's famous food near our hotel.

questions.why: 東部 is the eastern part: Hualien is in eastern Taiwan.
搭公車 means to take a bus. 騎 is for a bike (騎腳踏車); you never 騎 a bus.
After 得 comes how it went: 玩得很高興, they had a great time.
有名的 describes the noun after it: 花蓮有名的食物 is Hualien's famous food.

passage.traditional: 上個月我去高雄旅行。我{1}想住一家小旅館，可是那裡沒有房間了，後來住在一家大飯店。房間很漂亮，浴室也很{2}，洗澡很舒服。飯店離海邊很{3}，走路兩分鐘就到了。晚上我在海邊看風景，{4}了很多相片。
passage.simplified: 上个月我去高雄旅行。我{1}想住一家小旅馆，可是那里没有房间了，后来住在一家大饭店。房间很漂亮，浴室也很{2}，洗澡很舒服。饭店离海边很{3}，走路两分钟就到了。晚上我在海边看风景，{4}了很多相片。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè wǒ qù Gāoxióng lǚxíng. Wǒ běnlái xiǎng zhù yì jiā xiǎo lǚguǎn, kěshì nàlǐ méiyǒu fángjiān le, hòulái zhù zài yì jiā dà fàndiàn. Fángjiān hěn piàoliàng, yùshì yě hěn gānjìng, xǐzǎo hěn shūfu. Fàndiàn lí hǎibiān hěn jìn, zǒulù liǎng fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Wǎnshàng wǒ zài hǎibiān kàn fēngjǐng, zhào le hěn duō xiàngpiàn.
passage.english: Last month I took a trip to Kaohsiung. At first I wanted to stay at a small inn, but it had no rooms left, so in the end I stayed at a big hotel. The room was beautiful, and the bathroom was clean too, so showering was nice. The hotel was very close to the beach: it was a two-minute walk. In the evening I looked at the view by the sea and took lots of photos.

questions.why: 本來 gives the first plan; 後來 later in the sentence tells what changed.
浴室也很乾淨: the bathroom was clean too, so showering was nice.
離 + place + 很近: a two-minute walk means the hotel is close to the beach, not far (遠).
照相片 means to take photos: 照了很多相片, took lots of photos.

text.traditional:
姐姐：
今天老闆請我們吃晚飯，所以我下班以後不回家吃飯了。我十點以前一定回家，妳不要等我。
妹妹
text.simplified:
姐姐：
今天老板请我们吃晚饭，所以我下班以后不回家吃饭了。我十点以前一定回家，你不要等我。
妹妹
text.pinyin: Jiějie: Jīntiān lǎobǎn qǐng wǒmen chī wǎnfàn, suǒyǐ wǒ xiàbān yǐhòu bù huí jiā chī fàn le. Wǒ shí diǎn yǐqián yídìng huí jiā, nǐ búyào děng wǒ. Mèimei
text.english: Big sister, Today my boss is treating us to dinner, so I won't come home to eat after work. I'll definitely be home before ten, so don't wait for me. Your little sister

prompt.traditional: 妹妹今天晚上要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 妹妹今天晚上要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Mèimei jīntiān wǎnshàng yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What is the younger sister doing this evening?

choices.english: wait at home for her sister

questions.why: 老闆請我們吃晚飯 and 不回家吃飯: her boss is taking them to dinner, so she won't eat at home. She asks her sister not to wait for her.

text.traditional:
宜文：
這個星期六晚上，我們一起去看燈會吧！中明週末要上班，他說下班以後也會來。聽說今年的燈籠跟去年的一樣，有很多動物，大人小孩都喜歡。
友美
text.simplified:
宜文：
这个星期六晚上，我们一起去看灯会吧！中明周末要上班，他说下班以后也会来。听说今年的灯笼跟去年的一样，有很多动物，大人小孩都喜欢。
友美
text.pinyin: Yíwén: Zhège xīngqíliù wǎnshàng, wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn dēnghuì ba! Zhōngmíng zhōumò yào shàngbān, tā shuō xiàbān yǐhòu yě huì lái. Tīngshuō jīnnián de dēnglóng gēn qùnián de yíyàng, yǒu hěn duō dòngwù, dàrén xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān. Yǒuměi
text.english: Yiwen, let's go to the lantern show together this Saturday evening! Zhongming has to work this weekend, but he says he'll come too after work. I hear this year's lanterns are the same as last year's: there are lots of animals, and adults and children all like them. Youmei

prompt.pinyin: Jīnnián de dēnglóng zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What are this year's lanterns like?

questions.why: 今年的燈籠跟去年的一樣，有很多動物: this year's lanterns are like last year's, with lots of animals. The note says 一樣 (the same), not 不一樣, and 大人小孩都喜歡 means adults like them too, not only children.

focus.zh: 跟去年的一樣，有很多動物
focus.en: like last year's, with many animals
